020package com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api;
021
022import com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.grammar.java.JavaLanguageLexer;
023
024/**
025 * Contains the constants for all the tokens contained in the Abstract
026 * Syntax Tree.
027 *
028 * <p>Implementation detail: This class has been introduced to break
029 * the circular dependency between packages.</p>
030 *
031 * @noinspection ClassWithTooManyDependents
032 * @noinspectionreason ClassWithTooManyDependents - this class is a core part of our API
033 */
034public final class TokenTypes {
035
036    /**
037     * This is the root node for the source file.  It's children
038     * are an optional package definition, zero or more import statements,
039     * and zero or more type declarations.
040     *
041     * <p>For example:</p>
042     * <pre>
043     * import java.util.List;
044     *
045     * class MyClass{}
046     * interface MyInterface{}
047     * ;
048     * </pre>
049     *
050     * <p>parses as:</p>
051     *
052     * <pre>
053     * COMPILATION_UNIT -&gt; COMPILATION_UNIT
054     * |--IMPORT -&gt; import
055     * |   |--DOT -&gt; .
056     * |   |   |--DOT -&gt; .
057     * |   |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; java
058     * |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; util
059     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; List
060     * |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
061     * |--CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
062     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
063     * |   |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
064     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; MyClass
065     * |   `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
066     * |       |--LCURLY -&gt; {
067     * |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
068     * |--INTERFACE_DEF -&gt; INTERFACE_DEF
069     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
070     * |   |--LITERAL_INTERFACE -&gt; interface
071     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; MyInterface
072     * |   `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
073     * |       |--LCURLY -&gt; {
074     * |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
075     * `--SEMI -&gt; ;
076     * </pre>
077     *
078     * @see #PACKAGE_DEF
079     * @see #IMPORT
080     * @see #CLASS_DEF
081     * @see #INTERFACE_DEF
082     * @see #RECORD_DEF
083     * @see #ANNOTATION_DEF
084     * @see #ENUM_DEF
085     **/
086    public static final int COMPILATION_UNIT = JavaLanguageLexer.COMPILATION_UNIT;
087
088    /**
089     * The root of an AST for a JEP 512 (JDK 25) compact source file. This node
090     * replaces {@link #COMPILATION_UNIT} as the root when the source file declares
091     * any top-level method or field. It represents a {@code CompactCompilationUnit},
092     * which is one of the three mutually exclusive compilation-unit
093     * forms ({@code OrdinaryCompilationUnit}, {@code CompactCompilationUnit},
094     * {@code ModularCompilationUnit}). Import declarations and top-level members
095     * appear as direct children of this node. Compact source files cannot declare
096     * a package.
097     *
098     * <p>For example:</p>
099     * <pre>
100     * import java.util.List;
101     *
102     * int counter = 3;
103     * void main() {}
104     * </pre>
105     *
106     * <p>parses as:</p>
107     * <pre>
108     * COMPACT_COMPILATION_UNIT -&gt; COMPACT_COMPILATION_UNIT
109     * |--IMPORT -&gt; import
110     * |   |--DOT -&gt; .
111     * |   |   |--DOT -&gt; .
112     * |   |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; java
113     * |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; util
114     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; List
115     * |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
116     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
117     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
118     * |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
119     * |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
120     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; counter
121     * |   |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
122     * |   |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
123     * |   |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 3
124     * |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
125     * `--METHOD_DEF -&gt; METHOD_DEF
126     *     |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
127     *     |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
128     *     |   `--LITERAL_VOID -&gt; void
129     *     |--IDENT -&gt; main
130     *     |--LPAREN -&gt; (
131     *     |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
132     *     |--RPAREN -&gt; )
133     *     `--SLIST -&gt; {
134     *         `--RCURLY -&gt; }
135     * </pre>
136     *
137     * @see <a href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/512">JEP 512: Compact Source Files
138     *     and Instance Main Methods</a>
139     * @see #COMPILATION_UNIT
140     **/
141    public static final int COMPACT_COMPILATION_UNIT =
142            JavaLanguageLexer.COMPACT_COMPILATION_UNIT;
143
144    /**
145     * Modifiers for type, method, and field declarations.  The
146     * modifiers element is always present even though it may have no
147     * children.
148     *
149     * <p>For example:</p>
150     * <pre>
151     * public int x;
152     * </pre>
153     *
154     * <p>parses as:</p>
155     * <pre>
156     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
157     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
158     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
159     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
160     *  |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
161     *  |--IDENT -&gt; x
162     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
163     * </pre>
164     *
165     * @see <a
166     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-8.html">Java
167     *     Language Specification, &sect;8</a>
168     * @see #LITERAL_PUBLIC
169     * @see #LITERAL_PROTECTED
170     * @see #LITERAL_PRIVATE
171     * @see #ABSTRACT
172     * @see #LITERAL_STATIC
173     * @see #FINAL
174     * @see #LITERAL_TRANSIENT
175     * @see #LITERAL_VOLATILE
176     * @see #LITERAL_SYNCHRONIZED
177     * @see #LITERAL_NATIVE
178     * @see #STRICTFP
179     * @see #ANNOTATION
180     * @see #LITERAL_DEFAULT
181     **/
182    public static final int MODIFIERS = JavaLanguageLexer.MODIFIERS;
183
184    /**
185     * An object block.  These are children of class, interface, enum,
186     * annotation and enum constant declarations.
187     * Also, object blocks are children of the new keyword when defining
188     * anonymous inner types.
189     *
190     * <p>For example:</p>
191     * <pre>
192     * class Test {}
193     * </pre>
194     *
195     * <p>parses as:</p>
196     * <pre>
197     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
198     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
199     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
200     * |--IDENT -&gt; Test
201     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
202     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
203     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
204     * </pre>
205     *
206     * @see #LCURLY
207     * @see #INSTANCE_INIT
208     * @see #STATIC_INIT
209     * @see #CLASS_DEF
210     * @see #CTOR_DEF
211     * @see #METHOD_DEF
212     * @see #VARIABLE_DEF
213     * @see #RCURLY
214     * @see #INTERFACE_DEF
215     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
216     * @see #ENUM_DEF
217     * @see #ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF
218     * @see #ANNOTATION_DEF
219     **/
220    public static final int OBJBLOCK = JavaLanguageLexer.OBJBLOCK;
221    /**
222     * A list of statements.
223     *
224     * <p>For example:</p>
225     * <pre>
226     * if (c == 1) {
227     *     c = 0;
228     * }
229     * </pre>
230     *
231     * <p>parses as:</p>
232     * <pre>
233     * LITERAL_IF -&gt; if
234     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
235     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
236     *  |   `--EQUAL -&gt; ==
237     *  |       |--IDENT -&gt; c
238     *  |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
239     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
240     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
241     *      |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
242     *      |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
243     *      |       |--IDENT -&gt; c
244     *      |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
245     *      |--SEMI -&gt; ;
246     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
247     * </pre>
248     *
249     * @see #RCURLY
250     * @see #EXPR
251     * @see #LABELED_STAT
252     * @see #LITERAL_THROWS
253     * @see #LITERAL_RETURN
254     * @see #SEMI
255     * @see #METHOD_DEF
256     * @see #CTOR_DEF
257     * @see #LITERAL_FOR
258     * @see #LITERAL_WHILE
259     * @see #LITERAL_IF
260     * @see #LITERAL_ELSE
261     * @see #CASE_GROUP
262     **/
263    public static final int SLIST = JavaLanguageLexer.SLIST;
264    /**
265     * A constructor declaration.
266     *
267     * <p>For example:</p>
268     * <pre>
269     * public SpecialEntry(int value, String text)
270     * {
271     *   this.value = value;
272     *   this.text = text;
273     * }
274     * </pre>
275     *
276     * <p>parses as:</p>
277     * <pre>
278     * CTOR_DEF -&gt; CTOR_DEF
279     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
280     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
281     *  |--IDENT -&gt; SpecialEntry
282     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
283     *  |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
284     *  |   |--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
285     *  |   |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
286     *  |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
287     *  |   |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
288     *  |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; value
289     *  |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
290     *  |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
291     *  |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
292     *  |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
293     *  |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
294     *  |       `--IDENT -&gt; text
295     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
296     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
297     *      |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
298     *      |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
299     *      |       |--DOT -&gt; .
300     *      |   |--LITERAL_THIS -&gt; this
301     *      |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; value
302     *      |       `--IDENT -&gt; value
303     *      |--SEMI -&gt; ;
304     *      |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
305     *      |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
306     *      |       |--DOT -&gt; .
307     *      |       |   |--LITERAL_THIS -&gt; this
308     *      |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; text
309     *      |       `--IDENT -&gt; text
310     *      |--SEMI -&gt; ;
311     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
312     * </pre>
313     *
314     * @see #OBJBLOCK
315     * @see #CLASS_DEF
316     **/
317    public static final int CTOR_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.CTOR_DEF;
318    /**
319     * A method declaration.  The children are modifiers, type parameters,
320     * return type, method name, parameter list, an optional throws list, and
321     * statement list.  The statement list is omitted if the method
322     * declaration appears in an interface declaration.  Method
323     * declarations may appear inside object blocks of class
324     * declarations, interface declarations, enum declarations,
325     * enum constant declarations or anonymous inner-class declarations.
326     *
327     * <p>For example:</p>
328     *
329     * <pre>
330     *  public static int square(int x)
331     *  {
332     *    return x*x;
333     *  }
334     * </pre>
335     *
336     * <p>parses as:</p>
337     *
338     * <pre>
339     * --METHOD_DEF -&gt; METHOD_DEF
340     *    |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
341     *    |   |--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
342     *    |   `--LITERAL_STATIC -&gt; static
343     *    |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
344     *    |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
345     *    |--IDENT -&gt; square
346     *    |--LPAREN -&gt; (
347     *    |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
348     *    |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
349     *    |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
350     *    |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
351     *    |       |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
352     *    |       `--IDENT -&gt; x
353     *    |--RPAREN -&gt; )
354     *    `--SLIST -&gt; {
355     *        |--LITERAL_RETURN -&gt; return
356     *        |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
357     *        |   |   `--STAR -&gt; *
358     *        |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; x
359     *        |   |       `--IDENT -&gt; x
360     *        |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
361     *        `--RCURLY -&gt; }
362     * </pre>
363     *
364     * @see #MODIFIERS
365     * @see #TYPE_PARAMETERS
366     * @see #TYPE
367     * @see #IDENT
368     * @see #PARAMETERS
369     * @see #LITERAL_THROWS
370     * @see #SLIST
371     * @see #OBJBLOCK
372     **/
373    public static final int METHOD_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.METHOD_DEF;
374
375    /**
376     * A field or local variable declaration.  The children are
377     * modifiers, type, the identifier name, and an optional
378     * assignment statement.
379     *
380     * <p>For example:</p>
381     * <pre>
382     * final double PI = 3.14;
383     * </pre>
384     *
385     * <p>parses as:</p>
386     * <pre>
387     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
388     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
389     *  |   `--FINAL -&gt; final
390     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
391     *  |   `--LITERAL_DOUBLE -&gt; double
392     *  |--IDENT -&gt; PI
393     *  |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
394     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
395     *  |       `--NUM_FLOAT -&gt; 3.14
396     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
397     * </pre>
398     *
399     * @see #MODIFIERS
400     * @see #TYPE
401     * @see #IDENT
402     * @see #ASSIGN
403     **/
404    public static final int VARIABLE_DEF =
405        JavaLanguageLexer.VARIABLE_DEF;
406
407    /**
408     * An instance initializer.  Zero or more instance initializers
409     * may appear in class and enum definitions.  This token will be a child
410     * of the object block of the declaring type.
411     *
412     * <p>For example:</p>
413     * <pre>
414     * public class MyClass {
415     *     private int foo;
416     *     {foo = 10;}
417     * }
418     * </pre>
419     *
420     * <p>parses as:</p>
421     * <pre>
422     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
423     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
424     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
425     *  |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
426     *  |--IDENT -&gt; MyClass
427     *  `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
428     *      |--LCURLY -&gt; {
429     *      |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
430     *      |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
431     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_PRIVATE -&gt; private
432     *      |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
433     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
434     *      |   |--IDENT -&gt; foo
435     *      |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
436     *      |--INSTANCE_INIT -&gt; INSTANCE_INIT
437     *      |   `--SLIST -&gt; {
438     *      |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
439     *      |       |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
440     *      |       |       |--IDENT -&gt; foo
441     *      |       |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 10
442     *      |       |--SEMI -&gt; ;
443     *      |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
444     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
445     * </pre>
446     *
447     * @see <a
448     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.6">Java
449     *     Language Specification&sect;8.6</a>
450     * @see #SLIST
451     * @see #OBJBLOCK
452     **/
453    public static final int INSTANCE_INIT =
454        JavaLanguageLexer.INSTANCE_INIT;
455
456    /**
457     * A static initialization block.  Zero or more static
458     * initializers may be children of the object block of a class
459     * or enum declaration (interfaces cannot have static initializers).  The
460     * first and only child is a statement list.
461     *
462     * <p>For Example:</p>
463     * <pre>
464     * static {
465     *   num = 10;
466     * }
467     * </pre>
468     *
469     * <p>parses as:</p>
470     * <pre>
471     * STATIC_INIT -&gt; STATIC_INIT
472     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
473     *      |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
474     *      |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
475     *      |       |--IDENT -&gt; num
476     *      |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 10
477     *      |--SEMI -&gt; ;
478     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
479     * </pre>
480     *
481     * @see <a
482     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.7">Java
483     *     Language Specification, &sect;8.7</a>
484     * @see #SLIST
485     * @see #OBJBLOCK
486     **/
487    public static final int STATIC_INIT =
488        JavaLanguageLexer.STATIC_INIT;
489
490    /**
491     * A type.  This is either a return type of a method or a type of
492     * a variable or field.  The first child of this element is the
493     * actual type.  This may be a primitive type, an identifier, a
494     * dot which is the root of a fully qualified type, or an array of
495     * any of these. The second child may be type arguments to the type.
496     *
497     * <p>
498     * For example:
499     * {@code boolean var = true;}
500     * </p>
501     *
502     * <p>parses as:</p>
503     * <pre>
504     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
505     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
506     * |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
507     * |   |   `--LITERAL_BOOLEAN -&gt; boolean
508     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; var
509     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
510     * |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
511     * |           `--LITERAL_TRUE -&gt; true
512     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
513     * </pre>
514     *
515     * @see #VARIABLE_DEF
516     * @see #METHOD_DEF
517     * @see #PARAMETER_DEF
518     * @see #IDENT
519     * @see #DOT
520     * @see #LITERAL_VOID
521     * @see #LITERAL_BOOLEAN
522     * @see #LITERAL_BYTE
523     * @see #LITERAL_CHAR
524     * @see #LITERAL_SHORT
525     * @see #LITERAL_INT
526     * @see #LITERAL_FLOAT
527     * @see #LITERAL_LONG
528     * @see #LITERAL_DOUBLE
529     * @see #ARRAY_DECLARATOR
530     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENTS
531     **/
532    public static final int TYPE = JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE;
533    /**
534     * A class declaration.
535     *
536     * <p>For example:</p>
537     * <pre>
538     * public class Test {
539     * }
540     * </pre>
541     *
542     * <p>parses as:</p>
543     * <pre>
544     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
545     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
546     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
547     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
548     * |--IDENT -&gt; Test
549     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
550     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
551     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
552     * </pre>
553     *
554     * @see <a
555     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-8.html">Java
556     *     Language Specification, &sect;8</a>
557     * @see #MODIFIERS
558     * @see #IDENT
559     * @see #EXTENDS_CLAUSE
560     * @see #IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE
561     * @see #OBJBLOCK
562     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
563     **/
564    public static final int CLASS_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.CLASS_DEF;
565    /**
566     * An interface declaration.
567     *
568     * <p>For example:</p>
569     *
570     * <pre>
571     * public interface MyInterface {
572     *
573     * }
574     * </pre>
575     *
576     * <p>parses as:</p>
577     *
578     * <pre>
579     * INTERFACE_DEF -&gt; INTERFACE_DEF
580     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
581     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
582     * |--LITERAL_INTERFACE -&gt; interface
583     * |--IDENT -&gt; MyInterface
584     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
585     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
586     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
587     * </pre>
588     *
589     * @see <a
590     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-9.html">Java
591     *     Language Specification, &sect;9</a>
592     * @see #MODIFIERS
593     * @see #IDENT
594     * @see #EXTENDS_CLAUSE
595     * @see #OBJBLOCK
596     **/
597    public static final int INTERFACE_DEF =
598        JavaLanguageLexer.INTERFACE_DEF;
599
600    /**
601     * The package declaration.  This is optional, but if it is
602     * included, then there is only one package declaration per source
603     * file and it must be the first non-comment in the file. A package
604     * declaration may be annotated in which case the annotations comes
605     * before the rest of the declaration (and are the first children).
606     *
607     * <p>For example:</p>
608     *
609     * <pre>
610     *   package com.puppycrawl.tools.checkstyle.api;
611     * </pre>
612     *
613     * <p>parses as:</p>
614     *
615     * <pre>
616     * PACKAGE_DEF -&gt; package
617     * |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
618     * |--DOT -&gt; .
619     * |   |--DOT -&gt; .
620     * |   |   |--DOT -&gt; .
621     * |   |   |   |--DOT -&gt; .
622     * |   |   |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; com
623     * |   |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; puppycrawl
624     * |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; tools
625     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; checkstyle
626     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; api
627     * `--SEMI -&gt; ;
628     * </pre>
629     *
630     * @see <a
631     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.4">Java
632     *     Language Specification &sect;7.4</a>
633     * @see #DOT
634     * @see #IDENT
635     * @see #SEMI
636     * @see #ANNOTATIONS
637     * @see FullIdent
638     **/
639    public static final int PACKAGE_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.PACKAGE_DEF;
640    /**
641     * An array declaration.
642     *
643     * <p>If the array declaration represents a type, then the type of
644     * the array elements is the first child.  Multidimensional arrays
645     * may be regarded as arrays of arrays.  In other words, the first
646     * child of the array declaration is another array
647     * declaration.</p>
648     *
649     * <p>For example:</p>
650     * <pre>
651     *   int[] x;
652     * </pre>
653     *
654     * <p>parses as:</p>
655     * <pre>
656     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
657     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
658     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
659     *  |   |--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
660     *  |   `--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -&gt; [
661     *  |       `--RBRACK -&gt; ]
662     *  |--IDENT -&gt; x
663     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
664     * </pre>
665     *
666     * <p>The array declaration may also represent an inline array
667     * definition.  In this case, the first child will be either an
668     * expression specifying the length of the array or an array
669     * initialization block.</p>
670     *
671     * @see <a
672     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-10.html">Java
673     *     Language Specification &sect;10</a>
674     * @see #TYPE
675     * @see #ARRAY_INIT
676     **/
677    public static final int ARRAY_DECLARATOR =
678        JavaLanguageLexer.ARRAY_DECLARATOR;
679
680    /**
681     * An extends clause.  This appears as part of class and interface
682     * definitions.  This element appears even if the
683     * {@code extends} keyword is not explicitly used.  The child
684     * is an optional identifier.
685     *
686     * <p>For example:</p>
687     * <pre>
688     * public class Test extends ArrayList {
689     * }
690     * </pre>
691     *
692     * <p>parses as:</p>
693     * <pre>
694     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
695     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
696     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
697     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
698     * |--IDENT -&gt; Test
699     * |--EXTENDS_CLAUSE -&gt; extends
700     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; ArrayList
701     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
702     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
703     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
704     * </pre>
705     *
706     * @see #IDENT
707     * @see #DOT
708     * @see #CLASS_DEF
709     * @see #INTERFACE_DEF
710     * @see FullIdent
711     **/
712    public static final int EXTENDS_CLAUSE =
713        JavaLanguageLexer.EXTENDS_CLAUSE;
714
715    /**
716     * An implements clause.  This always appears in a class or enum
717     * declaration, even if there are no implemented interfaces.  The
718     * children are a comma separated list of zero or more
719     * identifiers.
720     *
721     * <p>For example:</p>
722     * <pre>
723     * public class MyClass implements Collection {
724     *
725     * }
726     * </pre>
727     *
728     * <p>parses as:</p>
729     * <pre>
730     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
731     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
732     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
733     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
734     * |--IDENT -&gt; MyClass
735     * |--IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE -&gt; implements
736     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; Collection
737     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
738     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
739     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
740     * </pre>
741     *
742     * @see #IDENT
743     * @see #DOT
744     * @see #COMMA
745     * @see #CLASS_DEF
746     * @see #ENUM_DEF
747     **/
748    public static final int IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE =
749        JavaLanguageLexer.IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE;
750
751    /**
752     * A list of parameters to a method or constructor.  The children
753     * are zero or more parameter declarations separated by commas.
754     *
755     * <p>For example</p>
756     * <pre>
757     * int start, int end
758     * </pre>
759     *
760     * <p>parses as:</p>
761     * <pre>
762     * PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
763     *  |--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
764     *  |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
765     *  |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
766     *  |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
767     *  |   `--IDENT -&gt; start
768     *  |--COMMA -&gt; ,
769     *  `--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
770     *      |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
771     *      |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
772     *      |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
773     *      `--IDENT -&gt; end
774     * </pre>
775     *
776     * @see #PARAMETER_DEF
777     * @see #COMMA
778     * @see #METHOD_DEF
779     * @see #CTOR_DEF
780     **/
781    public static final int PARAMETERS = JavaLanguageLexer.PARAMETERS;
782    /**
783     * A parameter declaration. The last parameter in a list of parameters may
784     * be variable length (indicated by the ELLIPSIS child node immediately
785     * after the TYPE child).
786     *
787     * <p>For example</p>
788     * <pre>
789     *      void foo(SomeType SomeType.this, int firstParameter, int... secondParameter) {}
790     * </pre>
791     *
792     * <p>parses as:</p>
793     * <pre>
794     * METHOD_DEF -&gt; METHOD_DEF
795     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
796     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
797     *  |   `--LITERAL_VOID -&gt; void
798     *  |--IDENT -&gt; foo
799     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
800     *  |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
801     *  |   |--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
802     *  |   |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
803     *  |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
804     *  |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; SomeType
805     *  |   |   `--DOT -&gt; .
806     *  |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; SomeType
807     *  |   |       `--LITERAL_THIS -&gt; this
808     *  |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
809     *  |   |--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
810     *  |   |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
811     *  |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
812     *  |   |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
813     *  |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; firstParameter
814     *  |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
815     *  |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
816     *  |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
817     *  |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
818     *  |       |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
819     *  |       |--ELLIPSIS -&gt; ...
820     *  |       `--IDENT -&gt; secondParameter
821     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
822     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
823     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
824     *
825     * </pre>
826     *
827     * @see #MODIFIERS
828     * @see #TYPE
829     * @see #IDENT
830     * @see #PARAMETERS
831     * @see #ELLIPSIS
832     **/
833    public static final int PARAMETER_DEF =
834        JavaLanguageLexer.PARAMETER_DEF;
835
836    /**
837     * A labeled statement.
838     *
839     * <p>For example:</p>
840     * <pre>
841     * outer:
842     * while (i &lt; 10) {
843     *     if (i == 5)
844     *         continue outer;
845     *     i++;
846     * }
847     * </pre>
848     *
849     * <p>parses as:</p>
850     * <pre>
851     * LABELED_STAT -&gt; :
852     *  |--IDENT -&gt; outer
853     *  `--LITERAL_WHILE -&gt; while
854     *      |--LPAREN -&gt; (
855     *      |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
856     *      |   `--LT -&gt; &lt;
857     *      |       |--IDENT -&gt; i
858     *      |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 10
859     *      |--RPAREN -&gt; )
860     *      `--SLIST -&gt; {
861     *          |--LITERAL_IF -&gt; if
862     *          |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
863     *          |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
864     *          |   |   `--EQUAL -&gt; ==
865     *          |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; i
866     *          |   |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 5
867     *          |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
868     *          |   `--LITERAL_CONTINUE -&gt; continue
869     *          |       |--IDENT -&gt; outer
870     *          |       `--SEMI -&gt; ;
871     *          |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
872     *          |   `--POST_INC -&gt; ++
873     *          |       `--IDENT -&gt; i
874     *          |--SEMI -&gt; ;
875     *          `--RCURLY -&gt; }
876     * </pre>
877     *
878     * @see <a
879     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-14.html#jls-14.7">Java
880     *     Language Specification, &sect;14.7</a>
881     * @see #SLIST
882     **/
883    public static final int LABELED_STAT =
884        JavaLanguageLexer.LABELED_STAT;
885
886    /**
887     * A type-cast.
888     *
889     * <p>For example:</p>
890     * <pre>
891     * (String)it.next()
892     * </pre>
893     *
894     * <p>parses as:</p>
895     * <pre>
896     * `--TYPECAST -&gt; (
897     *     |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
898     *     |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
899     *     |--RPAREN -&gt; )
900     *     `--METHOD_CALL -&gt; (
901     *         |--DOT -&gt; .
902     *         |   |--IDENT -&gt; it
903     *         |   `--IDENT -&gt; next
904     *         |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
905     *         `--RPAREN -&gt; )
906     * </pre>
907     *
908     * @see <a
909     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.16">Java
910     *     Language Specification, &sect;15.16</a>
911     * @see #EXPR
912     * @see #TYPE
913     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENTS
914     * @see #RPAREN
915     **/
916    public static final int TYPECAST = JavaLanguageLexer.TYPECAST;
917    /**
918     * The array index operator.
919     *
920     * <p>For example:</p>
921     * <pre>
922     * arr[0] = 10;
923     * </pre>
924     *
925     * <p>parses as:</p>
926     * <pre>
927     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
928     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
929     * |       |--INDEX_OP -&gt; [
930     * |       |   |--IDENT -&gt; arr
931     * |       |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
932     * |       |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
933     * |       |   `--RBRACK -&gt; ]
934     * |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 10
935     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
936     * </pre>
937     *
938     * @see #EXPR
939     **/
940    public static final int INDEX_OP = JavaLanguageLexer.INDEX_OP;
941    /**
942     * The {@code ++} (postfix increment) operator.
943     *
944     * <p>For example:</p>
945     * <pre>
946     * a++;
947     * </pre>
948     *
949     * <p>parses as:</p>
950     * <pre>
951     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
952     * |   `--POST_INC -&gt; ++
953     * |       `--IDENT -&gt; a
954     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
955     * </pre>
956     *
957     * @see <a
958     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.14.1">Java
959     *     Language Specification, &sect;15.14.1</a>
960     * @see #EXPR
961     * @see #INC
962     **/
963    public static final int POST_INC = JavaLanguageLexer.POST_INC;
964    /**
965     * The {@code --} (postfix decrement) operator.
966     *
967     * <p>For example:</p>
968     * <pre>
969     * a--;
970     * </pre>
971     *
972     * <p>parses as:</p>
973     * <pre>
974     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
975     * |   `--POST_DEC -&gt; --
976     * |       `--IDENT -&gt; a
977     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
978     * </pre>
979     *
980     * @see <a
981     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.14.2">Java
982     *     Language Specification, &sect;15.14.2</a>
983     * @see #EXPR
984     * @see #DEC
985     **/
986    public static final int POST_DEC = JavaLanguageLexer.POST_DEC;
987    /**
988     * A method call. A method call may have type arguments however these
989     * are attached to the appropriate node in the qualified method name.
990     *
991     * <p>For example:</p>
992     * <pre>
993     * Integer.parseInt("123");
994     * </pre>
995     *
996     * <p>parses as:</p>
997     * <pre>
998     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
999     * |   `--METHOD_CALL -&gt; (
1000     * |       |--DOT -&gt; .
1001     * |       |   |--IDENT -&gt; Integer
1002     * |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; parseInt
1003     * |       |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
1004     * |       |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1005     * |       |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "123"
1006     * |       `--RPAREN -&gt; )
1007     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
1008     * </pre>
1009     *
1010     *
1011     * @see #IDENT
1012     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENTS
1013     * @see #DOT
1014     * @see #ELIST
1015     * @see #RPAREN
1016     * @see FullIdent
1017     **/
1018    public static final int METHOD_CALL = JavaLanguageLexer.METHOD_CALL;
1019
1020    /**
1021     * A reference to a method or constructor without arguments. Part of Java 8 syntax.
1022     * The token should be used for subscribing for double colon literal.
1023     * {@link #DOUBLE_COLON} token does not appear in the tree.
1024     *
1025     * <p>For example:</p>
1026     * <pre>
1027     * Comparator&lt;String&gt; compare = String::compareToIgnoreCase;
1028     * </pre>
1029     *
1030     * <p>parses as:
1031     * <pre>
1032     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
1033     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
1034     * |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
1035     * |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; Comparator
1036     * |   |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
1037     * |   |       |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
1038     * |   |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
1039     * |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
1040     * |   |       `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
1041     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; compare
1042     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
1043     * |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1044     * |           `--METHOD_REF -&gt; ::
1045     * |               |--IDENT -&gt; String
1046     * |               `--IDENT -&gt; compareToIgnoreCase
1047     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
1048     * </pre>
1049     *
1050     * @see #IDENT
1051     * @see #DOUBLE_COLON
1052     */
1053    public static final int METHOD_REF = JavaLanguageLexer.METHOD_REF;
1054    /**
1055     * An expression.  Operators with lower precedence appear at a
1056     * higher level in the tree than operators with higher precedence.
1057     * Parentheses are siblings to the operator they enclose.
1058     *
1059     * <p>For example:</p>
1060     * <pre>
1061     * int x = 4 + 2 * (5 % 3) + (1 &lt;&lt; 3) - 4 * 5;
1062     * </pre>
1063     *
1064     * <p>parses as:</p>
1065     * <pre>
1066     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
1067     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
1068     * |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
1069     * |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
1070     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; x
1071     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
1072     * |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1073     * |           `--MINUS -&gt; -
1074     * |               |--PLUS -&gt; +
1075     * |               |   |--PLUS -&gt; +
1076     * |               |   |   |--NUM_INT -&gt; 4
1077     * |               |   |   `--STAR -&gt; *
1078     * |               |   |       |--NUM_INT -&gt; 2
1079     * |               |   |       |--LPAREN -&gt; (
1080     * |               |   |       |--MOD -&gt; %
1081     * |               |   |       |   |--NUM_INT -&gt; 5
1082     * |               |   |       |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 3
1083     * |               |   |       `--RPAREN -&gt; )
1084     * |               |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
1085     * |               |   |--SL -&gt; &lt;&lt;
1086     * |               |   |   |--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
1087     * |               |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 3
1088     * |               |   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
1089     * |               `--STAR -&gt; *
1090     * |                   |--NUM_INT -&gt; 4
1091     * |                   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 5
1092     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
1093     * </pre>
1094     *
1095     * @see #ELIST
1096     * @see #ASSIGN
1097     * @see #LPAREN
1098     * @see #RPAREN
1099     **/
1100    public static final int EXPR = JavaLanguageLexer.EXPR;
1101    /**
1102     * An array initialization.  This may occur as part of an array
1103     * declaration or inline with {@code new}.
1104     *
1105     * <p>For example:</p>
1106     * <pre>
1107     *   int[] y =
1108     *     {
1109     *       1,
1110     *       2,
1111     *     };
1112     * </pre>
1113     *
1114     * <p>parses as:</p>
1115     * <pre>
1116     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
1117     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
1118     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
1119     *  |   |--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
1120     *  |   `--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -&gt; [
1121     *  |       `--RBRACK -&gt; ]
1122     *  |--IDENT -&gt; y
1123     *  |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
1124     *  |   `--ARRAY_INIT -&gt; {
1125     *  |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1126     *  |       |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
1127     *  |       |--COMMA -&gt; ,
1128     *  |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1129     *  |       |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 2
1130     *  |       |--COMMA -&gt; ,
1131     *  |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
1132     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
1133     * </pre>
1134     *
1135     * <p>Also consider:</p>
1136     * <pre>
1137     *   int[] z = new int[]
1138     *     {
1139     *       1,
1140     *       2,
1141     *     };
1142     * </pre>
1143     *
1144     * <p>which parses as:</p>
1145     * <pre>
1146     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
1147     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
1148     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE [2:4]
1149     *  |   |--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
1150     *  |   `--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -&gt; [
1151     *  |       `--RBRACK -&gt; ]
1152     *  |--IDENT -&gt; z
1153     *  |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
1154     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1155     *  |       `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
1156     *  |           |--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
1157     *  |           |--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -&gt; [
1158     *  |           |   `--RBRACK -&gt; ]
1159     *  |           `--ARRAY_INIT -&gt; {
1160     *  |               |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1161     *  |               |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
1162     *  |               |--COMMA -&gt; ,
1163     *  |               |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1164     *  |               |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 2
1165     *  |               |--COMMA -&gt; ,
1166     *  |               `--RCURLY -&gt; }
1167     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
1168     * </pre>
1169     *
1170     * @see #ARRAY_DECLARATOR
1171     * @see #TYPE
1172     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
1173     * @see #COMMA
1174     **/
1175    public static final int ARRAY_INIT = JavaLanguageLexer.ARRAY_INIT;
1176    /**
1177     * An import declaration.  Import declarations are option, but
1178     * must appear after the package declaration and before the first type
1179     * declaration.
1180     *
1181     * <p>For example:</p>
1182     *
1183     * <pre>
1184     *   import java.io.IOException;
1185     * </pre>
1186     *
1187     * <p>parses as:</p>
1188     *
1189     * <pre>
1190     * IMPORT -&gt; import
1191     * |--DOT -&gt; .
1192     * |   |--DOT -&gt; .
1193     * |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; java
1194     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; io
1195     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; IOException
1196     * `--SEMI -&gt; ;
1197     * </pre>
1198     *
1199     * @see <a
1200     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.5">Java

1257    /**
1258     * A group of case clauses.  Case clauses with no associated
1259     * statements are grouped together into a case group.  The last
1260     * child is a statement list containing the statements to execute
1261     * upon a match.
1262     *

1264     * <pre>
1265     * case 0:

1267     * case 2:
1268     *   x = 3;
1269     *   break;
1270     * </pre>
1271     *
1272     * <p>parses as:</p>
1273     * <pre>
1274     * CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
1275     *  |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
1276     *  |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1277     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
1278     *  |   `--COLON -&gt; :
1279     *  |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
1280     *  |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1281     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
1282     *  |   `--COLON -&gt; :
1283     *  |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
1284     *  |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1285     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 2
1286     *  |   `--COLON -&gt; :
1287     *  `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
1288     *      |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1289     *      |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
1290     *      |       |--IDENT -&gt; x
1291     *      |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 3
1292     *      |--SEMI -&gt; ;
1293     *      `--LITERAL_BREAK -&gt; break
1294     *          `--SEMI -&gt; ;
1295     * </pre>

1299     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
1300     * @see #LITERAL_YIELD
1301     **/
1302    public static final int CASE_GROUP = JavaLanguageLexer.CASE_GROUP;
1303    /**
1304     * An expression list.  The children are a comma separated list of
1305     * expressions.

1307     * <p>For example:</p>
1308     * <pre>
1309     * new ArrayList(50);
1310     * </pre>

1313     * <pre>

1317     * |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
1318     * |       |   |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
1319     * |       |   `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
1320     * |       |--LPAREN -&gt; (
1321     * |       |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
1322     * |       |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1323     * |       |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 50
1324     * |       `--RPAREN -&gt; )
1325     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
1326     * </pre>

1328     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
1329     * @see #FOR_INIT
1330     * @see #FOR_ITERATOR

1333     * @see #CTOR_CALL
1334     * @see #SUPER_CTOR_CALL
1335     **/
1336    public static final int ELIST = JavaLanguageLexer.ELIST;
1337    /**
1338     * A for loop initializer.  This is a child of
1339     * {@code LITERAL_FOR}.  The children of this element may be
1340     * a comma separated list of variable declarations, an expression
1341     * list, or empty.
1342     *
1343     * <p>For example:</p>
1344     * <pre>
1345     * for (int i = 0; i &lt; arr.length; i++) {}
1346     * </pre>

1349     * <pre>
1350     * LITERAL_FOR -&gt; for
1351     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
1352     *  |--FOR_INIT -&gt; FOR_INIT
1353     *  |   `--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
1354     *  |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
1355     *  |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
1356     *  |       |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
1357     *  |       |--IDENT -&gt; i
1358     *  |       `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
1359     *  |           `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1360     *  |               `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
1361     *  |--SEMI -&gt; ;
1362     *  |--FOR_CONDITION -&gt; FOR_CONDITION
1363     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1364     *  |       `--LT -&gt; &lt;
1365     *  |           |--IDENT -&gt; i
1366     *  |           `--DOT -&gt; .
1367     *  |               |--IDENT -&gt; arr
1368     *  |               `--IDENT -&gt; length
1369     *  |--SEMI -&gt; ;
1370     *  |--FOR_ITERATOR -&gt; FOR_ITERATOR
1371     *  |   `--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
1372     *  |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
1373     *  |           `--POST_INC -&gt; ++
1374     *  |               `--IDENT -&gt; i
1375     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
1376     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
1377     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
1378     * </pre>
1379     *
1380     * @see #VARIABLE_DEF
1381     * @see #ELIST
1382     * @see #LITERAL_FOR
1383     **/
1384    public static final int FOR_INIT = JavaLanguageLexer.FOR_INIT;

1421     *  |               `--IDENT -&gt; i

1424     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }

2425     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
2426     *  |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
2427     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2428     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
2429     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
2430     * </pre>
2431     *
2432     * @see #LITERAL_FOR
2433     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
2434     * @see #METHOD_CALL
2435     * @see #TYPECAST
2436     * @see #EXPR
2437     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
2438     * @see #LITERAL_CATCH
2439     **/
2440    public static final int RPAREN = JavaLanguageLexer.RPAREN;
2441    /**
2442     * The {@code this} keyword use to refer the current object.
2443     * This can also be used to call the constructor.
2444     *
2445     * <p>For example:</p>
2446     * <pre>
2447     * this.name = name;
2448     * </pre>
2449     *
2450     * <p>parses as:</p>
2451     * <pre>
2452     * EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2453     *  `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
2454     *      |--DOT -&gt; .
2455     *      |   |--LITERAL_THIS -&gt; this
2456     *      |   `--IDENT -&gt; name
2457     *      `--IDENT -&gt; name
2458     * SEMI -&gt; ;
2459     * </pre>
2460     *
2461     * <p>Also consider:</p>
2462     * <pre>
2463     * this(1, "NULL");
2464     * </pre>
2465     *
2466     * <p>parses as:</p>
2467     * <pre>
2468     * CTOR_CALL -&gt; this
2469     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
2470     *  |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
2471     *  |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2472     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
2473     *  |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
2474     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2475     *  |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "NULL"
2476     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2477     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
2478     * </pre>
2479     *
2480     * @see #EXPR
2481     * @see #CTOR_CALL
2482     **/
2483    public static final int LITERAL_THIS =
2484        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_THIS;
2485
2486    /**
2487     * The {@code super} keyword.
2488     *
2489     * <p>For example:</p>
2490     * <pre>
2491     * super.toString()；
2492     * </pre>
2493     *
2494     * <p>parses as:</p>
2495     * <pre>
2496     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2497     * |   `--METHOD_CALL -&gt; (
2498     * |       |--DOT -&gt; .
2499     * |       |  |--LITERAL_SUPER -&gt; super
2500     * |       |  `--IDENT -&gt; toString
2501     * |       |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
2502     * |       `--RPAREN -&gt; )
2503     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2504     * </pre>
2505     *
2506     * @see #EXPR
2507     * @see #SUPER_CTOR_CALL

2509    public static final int LITERAL_SUPER =
2510        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_SUPER;

2512    /**
2513     * The {@code =} (assignment) operator.

2517     * a = b;
2518     * </pre>
2519     *
2520     * <p>parses as:</p>
2521     * <pre>
2522     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2523     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
2524     * |       |--IDENT -&gt; a
2525     * |       `--IDENT -&gt; b
2526     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2527     * </pre>
2528     *
2529     * @see <a
2530     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.26.1">Java
2531     *     Language Specification, &sect;15.26.1</a>
2532     * @see #EXPR
2533     **/
2534    public static final int ASSIGN = JavaLanguageLexer.ASSIGN;
2535    /**
2536     * The {@code throws} keyword.  The children are a number of
2537     * one or more identifiers separated by commas.
2538     *
2539     * <p>For example:</p>
2540     * <pre>
2541     * void test() throws FileNotFoundException, EOFException {
2542     * }
2543     * </pre>
2544     *
2545     * <p>parses as:</p>
2546     * <pre>
2547     * METHOD_DEF -&gt; METHOD_DEF
2548     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
2549     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
2550     *  |   `--LITERAL_VOID -&gt; void
2551     *  |--IDENT -&gt; test
2552     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
2553     *  |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
2554     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2555     *  |--LITERAL_THROWS -&gt; throws
2556     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; FileNotFoundException
2557     *  |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
2558     *  |   `--IDENT -&gt; EOFException
2559     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
2560     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
2561     * </pre>
2562     *
2563     * @see <a
2564     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.4.4">Java
2565     *     Language Specification, &sect;8.4.4</a>
2566     * @see #IDENT
2567     * @see #DOT
2568     * @see #COMMA
2569     * @see #METHOD_DEF
2570     * @see #CTOR_DEF
2571     * @see FullIdent
2572     **/
2573    public static final int LITERAL_THROWS =
2574        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_THROWS;

2576    /**
2577     * The {@code :} (colon) operator.  This will appear as part
2578     * of the conditional operator ({@code ? :}).
2579     *
2580     * <p>For example:</p>
2581     * <pre>
2582     * num = isValid ? 1 : 0;
2583     * </pre>
2584     *
2585     * <p>parses as:</p>
2586     * <pre>
2587     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2588     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
2589     * |       |--IDENT -&gt; num
2590     * |       `--QUESTION -&gt; ?
2591     * |           |--IDENT -&gt; isValid
2592     * |           |--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
2593     * |           |--COLON -&gt; :
2594     * |           `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
2595     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2596     * </pre>
2597     *
2598     * @see #QUESTION
2599     * @see #LABELED_STAT
2600     * @see #CASE_GROUP
2601     **/
2602    public static final int COLON = JavaLanguageLexer.COLON;

2604    /**
2605     * The {@code ::} (double colon) separator.
2606     * It is part of Java 8 syntax that is used for method reference.
2607     * The token does not appear in tree, {@link #METHOD_REF} should be used instead.
2608     *
2609     * <p>For example:</p>
2610     * <pre>
2611     * Function&lt;Double, Double&gt; square = MyClass::square;
2612     * </pre>
2613     *
2614     * <p>parses as:</p>
2615     * <pre>
2616     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
2617     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
2618     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
2619     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; Function
2620     *  |   |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
2621     *  |   |       |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
2622     *  |   |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
2623     *  |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; Double
2624     *  |   |       |--COMMA -&gt; ,
2625     *  |   |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
2626     *  |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; Double
2627     *  |   |       `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
2628     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; square
2629     *  |   |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
2630     *  |   |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2631     *  |   |       `--METHOD_REF -&gt; ::
2632     *  |   |           |--IDENT -&gt; MyClass
2633     *  |   |           `--IDENT -&gt; square
2634     *  |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
2635     * </pre>
2636     *
2637     * @see #METHOD_REF
2638     */
2639    public static final int DOUBLE_COLON = JavaLanguageLexer.DOUBLE_COLON;
2640    /**
2641     * The {@code if} keyword.
2642     *
2643     * <p>For example:</p>
2644     * <pre>
2645     * if (optimistic)
2646     * {
2647     *   message = "half full";
2648     * }
2649     * else
2650     * {
2651     *   message = "half empty";
2652     * }
2653     * </pre>
2654     *
2655     * <p>parses as:</p>
2656     * <pre>
2657     * LITERAL_IF -&gt; if
2658     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
2659     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2660     *  |   `--IDENT -&gt; optimistic
2661     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2662     *  |--SLIST -&gt; {
2663     *  |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2664     *  |   |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
2665     *  |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; message
2666     *  |   |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "half full"
2667     *  |   |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2668     *  |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
2669     *  `--LITERAL_ELSE -&gt; else
2670     *      `--SLIST -&gt; {
2671     *          |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2672     *          |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
2673     *          |       |--IDENT -&gt; message
2674     *          |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "half empty"
2675     *          |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2676     *          `--RCURLY -&gt; }
2677     * </pre>
2678     *
2679     * @see #LPAREN
2680     * @see #EXPR
2681     * @see #RPAREN
2682     * @see #SLIST
2683     * @see #EMPTY_STAT
2684     * @see #LITERAL_ELSE
2685     **/
2686    public static final int LITERAL_IF = JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_IF;
2687    /**
2688     * The {@code for} keyword.  The children are {@code (},
2689     * an initializer, a condition, an iterator, a {@code )} and
2690     * either a statement list, a single expression, or an empty
2691     * statement.
2692     *
2693     * <p>For example:</p>
2694     * <pre>
2695     * for (int i = 0; i &lt; arr.length; i++) {}
2696     * </pre>
2697     *
2698     * <p>parses as:</p>
2699     * <pre>
2700     * LITERAL_FOR -&gt; for
2701     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
2702     *  |--FOR_INIT -&gt; FOR_INIT
2703     *  |   `--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
2704     *  |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
2705     *  |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
2706     *  |       |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
2707     *  |       |--IDENT -&gt; i
2708     *  |       `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
2709     *  |           `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2710     *  |               `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
2711     *  |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2712     *  |--FOR_CONDITION -&gt; FOR_CONDITION
2713     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2714     *  |       `--LT -&gt; &lt;
2715     *  |           |--IDENT -&gt; i
2716     *  |           `--DOT -&gt; .
2717     *  |               |--IDENT -&gt; arr
2718     *  |               `--IDENT -&gt; length
2719     *  |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2720     *  |--FOR_ITERATOR -&gt; FOR_ITERATOR
2721     *  |   `--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
2722     *  |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2723     *  |           `--POST_INC -&gt; ++
2724     *  |               `--IDENT -&gt; i
2725     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2726     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
2727     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
2728     * </pre>
2729     *
2730     * @see #LPAREN
2731     * @see #FOR_INIT
2732     * @see #SEMI
2733     * @see #FOR_CONDITION
2734     * @see #FOR_ITERATOR
2735     * @see #RPAREN
2736     * @see #SLIST
2737     * @see #EMPTY_STAT
2738     * @see #EXPR
2739     **/
2740    public static final int LITERAL_FOR = JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_FOR;
2741    /**
2742     * The {@code while} keyword.
2743     *
2744     * <p>For example:</p>
2745     * <pre>
2746     * while (i &lt; 5) {
2747     *     i++;
2748     * }

2752     * <pre>
2753     * LITERAL_WHILE -&gt; while

2755     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2756     *  |   `--LT -&gt; &lt;
2757     *  |       |--IDENT -&gt; i
2758     *  |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 5
2759     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2760     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
2761     *      |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2762     *      |   `--POST_INC -&gt; ++
2763     *      |       `--IDENT -&gt; i
2764     *      |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2765     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
2766     * </pre>
2767     **/
2768    public static final int LITERAL_WHILE =
2769        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_WHILE;
2770
2771    /**
2772     * The {@code do} keyword.  Note that the while token does not
2773     * appear as part of the do-while construct.
2774     *
2775     * <p>For example:</p>

2782     * <p>parses as:</p>
2783     * <pre>
2784     * LITERAL_DO -&gt; do
2785     *  |--SLIST -&gt; {
2786     *  |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2787     *  |   |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
2788     *  |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; x
2789     *  |   |       `--METHOD_CALL -&gt; (
2790     *  |   |           |--DOT -&gt; .
2791     *  |   |           |   |--IDENT -&gt; rand
2792     *  |   |           |   `--IDENT -&gt; nextInt
2793     *  |   |           |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
2794     *  |   |           `--RPAREN -&gt; )
2795     *  |   |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2796     *  |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
2797     *  |--DO_WHILE -&gt; while
2798     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
2799     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2800     *  |   `--LT -&gt; &lt;
2801     *  |       |--IDENT -&gt; x
2802     *  |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 5
2803     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2804     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
2805     * </pre>
2806     *
2807     * @see #SLIST
2808     * @see #EXPR
2809     * @see #EMPTY_STAT
2810     * @see #LPAREN
2811     * @see #RPAREN
2812     * @see #SEMI
2813     **/
2814    public static final int LITERAL_DO = JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_DO;
2815    /**
2816     * Literal {@code while} in do-while loop.

2819     * <pre>
2820     * do {
2821     *

2823     * </pre>

2825     * <p>parses as:</p>
2826     * <pre>
2827     * --LITERAL_DO -&gt; do

2829     *    |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
2830     *    |--DO_WHILE -&gt; while
2831     *    |--LPAREN -&gt; (
2832     *    |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2833     *    |   `--GT -&gt; &gt;
2834     *    |       |--IDENT -&gt; a
2835     *    |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
2836     *    |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2837     *    `--SEMI -&gt; ;
2838     * </pre>

2840     * @see #LITERAL_DO
2841     */
2842    public static final int DO_WHILE = JavaLanguageLexer.DO_WHILE;
2843    /**
2844     * The {@code break} keyword.  The first child is an optional

2865     *      |--LITERAL_BREAK -&gt; break

2877    /**

2898     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
2899     *      |--LITERAL_CONTINUE -&gt; continue
2900     *      |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;

2904     * @see #IDENT

2906     * @see #SLIST

2911    /**
2912     * The {@code return} keyword.  The first child is an

2929     *  |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
2930     *  |--IDENT -&gt; foo
2931     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
2932     *  |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
2933     *  |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
2934     *  |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
2935     *  |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
2936     *  |       |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
2937     *  |       `--IDENT -&gt; i
2938     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2939     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
2940     *      |--LITERAL_RETURN -&gt; return
2941     *      |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2942     *      |   |   `--PLUS -&gt; +
2943     *      |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; i
2944     *      |   |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
2945     *      |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
2946     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }

2956    /**
2957     * The {@code switch} keyword.
2958     *
2959     * <p>For example:</p>
2960     * <pre>
2961     * switch (type) {
2962     *      case 0:
2963     *          background = Color.red;
2964     *          break;
2965     *      case 1:
2966     *          background = Color.blue;
2967     *          break;
2968     *      default:
2969     *          background = Color.green;
2970     * }
2971     * </pre>
2972     *
2973     * <p>parses as:</p>
2974     * <pre>
2975     * LITERAL_SWITCH -&gt; switch
2976     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
2977     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2978     *  |   `--IDENT -&gt; type
2979     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
2980     *  |--LCURLY -&gt; {
2981     *  |--CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
2982     *  |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
2983     *  |   |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2984     *  |   |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
2985     *  |   |   `--COLON -&gt; :
2986     *  |   `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
2987     *  |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2988     *  |       |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
2989     *  |       |       |--IDENT -&gt; background
2990     *  |       |       `--DOT -&gt; .
2991     *  |       |           |--IDENT -&gt; Color
2992     *  |       |           `--IDENT -&gt; red
2993     *  |       |--SEMI -&gt; ;
2994     *  |       `--LITERAL_BREAK -&gt; break
2995     *  |           `--SEMI -&gt; ;
2996     *  |--CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
2997     *  |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
2998     *  |   |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
2999     *  |   |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
3000     *  |   |   `--COLON -&gt; :
3001     *  |   `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
3002     *  |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3003     *  |       |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3004     *  |       |       |--IDENT -&gt; background
3005     *  |       |       `--DOT -&gt; .
3006     *  |       |           |--IDENT -&gt; Color
3007     *  |       |           `--IDENT -&gt; blue
3008     *  |       |--SEMI -&gt; ;
3009     *  |       `--LITERAL_BREAK -&gt; break
3010     *  |           `--SEMI -&gt; ;
3011     *  |--CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
3012     *  |   |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -&gt; default
3013     *  |   |   `--COLON -&gt; :
3014     *  |   `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
3015     *  |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3016     *  |       |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3017     *  |       |       |--IDENT -&gt; background
3018     *  |       |       `--DOT -&gt; .
3019     *  |       |           |--IDENT -&gt; Color
3020     *  |       |           `--IDENT -&gt; green
3021     *  |       `--SEMI -&gt; ;
3022     *  `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3023     * </pre>
3024     *
3025     * @see <a
3026     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-14.html#jls-14.10">Java
3027     *     Language Specification, &sect;14.10</a>
3028     * @see #LPAREN
3029     * @see #EXPR
3030     * @see #RPAREN
3031     * @see #LCURLY
3032     * @see #CASE_GROUP
3033     * @see #RCURLY
3034     * @see #SLIST
3035     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
3036     **/
3037    public static final int LITERAL_SWITCH =
3038        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_SWITCH;
3039
3040    /**
3041     * The {@code throw} keyword.  The first child is an
3042     * expression that evaluates to a {@code Throwable} instance.
3043     *
3044     * <p>For example:</p>
3045     * <pre>
3046     * throw new ArithmeticException(&quot;An exception occurred.&quot;);
3047     * </pre>
3048     *
3049     * <p>parses as:</p>
3050     * <pre>
3051     * LITERAL_THROW -&gt; throw
3052     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3053     *  |   `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
3054     *  |       |--IDENT -&gt; ArithmeticException
3055     *  |       |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3056     *  |       |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
3057     *  |       |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3058     *  |       |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; &quot;An exception occurred.&quot;
3059     *  |       `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3060     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
3061     * </pre>
3062     *
3063     * @see <a
3064     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-14.html#jls-14.17">Java
3065     *     Language Specification, &sect;14.17</a>
3066     * @see #SLIST
3067     * @see #EXPR
3068     **/
3069    public static final int LITERAL_THROW =
3070        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_THROW;
3071
3072    /**
3073     * The {@code else} keyword.  This appears as a child of an
3074     * {@code if} statement.
3075     *
3076     * <p>For example:</p>
3077     * <pre>
3078     * if (flag) {
3079     *
3080     * } else {
3081     *
3082     * }
3083     * </pre>
3084     *
3085     * <p>parses as:</p>
3086     * <pre>
3087     * LITERAL_IF -&gt; if
3088     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3089     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3090     *  |   `--IDENT -&gt; flag
3091     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
3092     *  |--SLIST -&gt; {
3093     *  |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3094     *  `--LITERAL_ELSE -&gt; else
3095     *      `--SLIST -&gt; {
3096     *          `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3097     * </pre>
3098     *
3099     * @see #SLIST
3100     * @see #EXPR
3101     * @see #EMPTY_STAT
3102     * @see #LITERAL_IF
3103     **/
3104    public static final int LITERAL_ELSE =
3105        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_ELSE;
3106
3107    /**
3108     * The {@code case} keyword.  The first child is a constant
3109     * expression that evaluates to an integer.
3110     *
3111     * <p>For example:</p>
3112     * <pre>
3113     * switch(num){
3114     *    case 0:
3115     *      num = 1;
3116     * }
3117     * </pre>
3118     *
3119     * <p>parses as:</p>
3120     * <pre>
3121     *
3122     * CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
3123     *    |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; cas
3124     *    |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3125     *    |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
3126     *    |   `--COLON -&gt; :
3127     *    `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
3128     *         |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3129     *         |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3130     *         |       |--IDENT -&gt; num
3131     *         |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
3132     *         `--SEMI -&gt; ;
3133     * </pre>
3134     *
3135     * <p>For example:</p>
3136     * <pre>
3137     * switch(num){
3138     *    case 1 -&gt; num = -1
3139     * }
3140     * </pre>
3141     *
3142     * <p>parses as:</p>
3143     * <pre>
3144     * SWITCH_RULE -&gt; SWITCH_RULE
3145     *   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
3146     *   |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3147     *   |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
3148     *   |--LAMBDA -&gt; -&gt;
3149     *   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3150     *   |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3151     *   |       |--IDENT -&gt; num
3152     *   |       `--UNARY_MINUS -&gt; -
3153     *   |           `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
3154     *   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
3155     * </pre>
3156     *
3157     * @see #CASE_GROUP
3158     * @see #EXPR
3159     **/
3160    public static final int LITERAL_CASE =
3161        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_CASE;
3162
3163    /**
3164     * The {@code default} keyword.  This element has no
3165     * children.
3166     *
3167     * <p>For example:</p>
3168     * <pre>
3169     * switch (type) {
3170     *   case 1:
3171     *     x = 1;
3172     *     break;
3173     *   default:
3174     *     x = 3;
3175     * }
3176     * </pre>
3177     *
3178     * <p>parses as:</p>
3179     * <pre>
3180     * LITERAL_SWITCH -&gt; switch
3181     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3182     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3183     *  |   `--IDENT -&gt; type
3184     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
3185     *  |--LCURLY -&gt; {
3186     *  |--CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
3187     *  |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
3188     *  |   |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3189     *  |   |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
3190     *  |   |   `--COLON -&gt; :
3191     *  |   `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
3192     *  |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3193     *  |       |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3194     *  |       |       |--IDENT -&gt; x
3195     *  |       |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
3196     *  |       |   |       |--SEMI -&gt; ;
3197     *  |       `--LITERAL_BREAK -&gt; break
3198     *  |           `--SEMI -&gt; ;
3199     *  |--CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
3200     *  |   |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -&gt; default
3201     *  |   |   `--COLON -&gt; :
3202     *  |   `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
3203     *  |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3204     *  |       |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3205     *  |       |       |--IDENT -&gt; x
3206     *  |       |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 3
3207     *  |       `--SEMI -&gt; ;
3208     *  `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3209     * </pre>
3210     *
3211     * @see #CASE_GROUP
3212     * @see #MODIFIERS
3213     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
3214     **/
3215    public static final int LITERAL_DEFAULT =
3216        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_DEFAULT;
3217
3218    /**
3219     * The {@code try} keyword.  The children are a statement
3220     * list, zero or more catch blocks and then an optional finally
3221     * block.
3222     *
3223     * <p>For example:</p>
3224     * <pre>
3225     * try { } finally {}
3226     * </pre>
3227     *
3228     * <p>parses as:</p>
3229     * <pre>
3230     * LITERAL_TRY -&gt; try
3231     *  |--SLIST -&gt; {
3232     *  |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3233     *  `--LITERAL_FINALLY -&gt; finally
3234     *      `--SLIST -&gt; {
3235     *          `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3236     * </pre>
3237     *
3238     * @see <a
3239     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-14.html#jls-14.19">Java
3240     *     Language Specification, &sect;14.19</a>
3241     * @see #SLIST
3242     * @see #LITERAL_CATCH
3243     * @see #LITERAL_FINALLY
3244     **/
3245    public static final int LITERAL_TRY = JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_TRY;
3246
3247    /**
3248     * The Java 7 try-with-resources construct.
3249     *
3250     * <p>For example:</p>
3251     * <pre>
3252     * try (Foo foo = new Foo(); Bar bar = new Bar()) {
3253     * }
3254     * </pre>
3255     *
3256     * <p>parses as:</p>
3257     * <pre>
3258     * LITERAL_TRY -&gt; try
3259     *  |--RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION -&gt; RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION
3260     *  |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3261     *  |   |--RESOURCES -&gt; RESOURCES
3262     *  |   |   |--RESOURCE -&gt; RESOURCE
3263     *  |   |   |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
3264     *  |   |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
3265     *  |   |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; Foo
3266     *  |   |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; foo
3267     *  |   |   |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3268     *  |   |   |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3269     *  |   |   |           `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
3270     *  |   |   |               |--IDENT -&gt; Foo
3271     *  |   |   |               |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3272     *  |   |   |               |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
3273     *  |   |   |               `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3274     *  |   |   |--SEMI -&gt; ;
3275     *  |   |   `--RESOURCE -&gt; RESOURCE
3276     *  |   |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
3277     *  |   |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
3278     *  |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; Bar
3279     *  |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; bar
3280     *  |   |       `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3281     *  |   |           `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3282     *  |   |               `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
3283     *  |   |                   |--IDENT -&gt; Bar
3284     *  |   |                   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3285     *  |   |                   |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
3286     *  |   |                   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3287     *  |   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3288     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
3289     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3290     * </pre>
3291     *
3292     * <p>Also consider:</p>
3293     * <pre>
3294     * try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(path))) {
3295     * }
3296     * </pre>
3297     *
3298     * <p>which parses as:</p>
3299     * <pre>
3300     * LITERAL_TRY -&gt; try
3301     *  |--RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION -&gt; RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION
3302     *  |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3303     *  |   |--RESOURCES -&gt; RESOURCES
3304     *  |   |   `--RESOURCE -&gt; RESOURCE
3305     *  |   |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
3306     *  |   |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
3307     *  |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; BufferedReader
3308     *  |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; br
3309     *  |   |       `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3310     *  |   |           `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3311     *  |   |               `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
3312     *  |   |                   |--IDENT -&gt; BufferedReader
3313     *  |   |                   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3314     *  |   |                   |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
3315     *  |   |                   |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3316     *  |   |                   |       `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
3317     *  |   |                   |           |--IDENT -&gt; FileReader
3318     *  |   |                   |           |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3319     *  |   |                   |           |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
3320     *  |   |                   |           |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3321     *  |   |                   |           |       `--IDENT -&gt; path
3322     *  |   |                   |           `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3323     *  |   |                   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3324     *  |   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3325     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
3326     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3327     * </pre>
3328     *
3329     * @see #LPAREN
3330     * @see #RESOURCES
3331     * @see #RESOURCE
3332     * @see #SEMI
3333     * @see #RPAREN
3334     * @see #LITERAL_TRY
3335     **/
3336    public static final int RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION =
3337        JavaLanguageLexer.RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION;
3338
3339    /**
3340     * A list of resources in the Java 7 try-with-resources construct.
3341     * This is a child of RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION.
3342     *
3343     * <p>For example:</p>
3344     * <pre>
3345     *     try (FileReader fr = new FileReader("config.xml")) {
3346     *     } finally {}
3347     * </pre>
3348     *
3349     * <p>parses as:</p>
3350     * <pre>
3351     * LITERAL_TRY -&gt; try
3352     *  |--RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION -&gt; RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION
3353     *  |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3354     *  |   |--RESOURCES -&gt; RESOURCES
3355     *  |   |   `--RESOURCE -&gt; RESOURCE
3356     *  |   |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
3357     *  |   |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
3358     *  |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; FileReader
3359     *  |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; fr
3360     *  |   |       `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3361     *  |   |           `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3362     *  |   |               `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
3363     *  |   |                   |--IDENT -&gt; FileReader
3364     *  |   |                   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3365     *  |   |                   |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
3366     *  |   |                   |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3367     *  |   |                   |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "config.xml"
3368     *  |   |                   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3369     *  |   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3370     *  |--SLIST -&gt; {
3371     *  |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3372     *  `--LITERAL_FINALLY -&gt; finally
3373     *      `--SLIST -&gt; {
3374     *          `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3375     * </pre>
3376     *
3377     * @see #RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION
3378     **/
3379    public static final int RESOURCES =
3380        JavaLanguageLexer.RESOURCES;
3381
3382    /**
3383     * A resource in the Java 7 try-with-resources construct.
3384     * This is a child of RESOURCES.
3385     *
3386     * <p>For example:</p>
3387     * <pre>
3388     * try (Foo foo = new Foo(); Bar bar = new Bar()) { }
3389     * </pre>
3390     *
3391     * <p>parses as:</p>
3392     * <pre>
3393     * LITERAL_TRY -&gt; try
3394     *  |--RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION -&gt; RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION
3395     *  |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3396     *  |   |--RESOURCES -&gt; RESOURCES
3397     *  |   |   |--RESOURCE -&gt; RESOURCE
3398     *  |   |   |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
3399     *  |   |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
3400     *  |   |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; Foo
3401     *  |   |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; foo
3402     *  |   |   |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3403     *  |   |   |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3404     *  |   |   |           `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
3405     *  |   |   |               |--IDENT -&gt; Foo
3406     *  |   |   |               |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3407     *  |   |   |               |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
3408     *  |   |   |               `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3409     *  |   |   |--SEMI -&gt; ;
3410     *  |   |   `--RESOURCE -&gt; RESOURCE
3411     *  |   |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
3412     *  |   |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
3413     *  |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; Bar
3414     *  |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; bar
3415     *  |   |       `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3416     *  |   |           `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3417     *  |   |               `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
3418     *  |   |                   |--IDENT -&gt; Bar
3419     *  |   |                   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3420     *  |   |                   |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
3421     *  |   |                   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3422     *  |   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3423     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
3424     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3425     * </pre>
3426     *
3427     * @see #RESOURCES
3428     * @see #RESOURCE_SPECIFICATION
3429     **/
3430    public static final int RESOURCE =
3431        JavaLanguageLexer.RESOURCE;
3432
3433    /**
3434     * The {@code catch} keyword.
3435     *
3436     * <p>For example:</p>
3437     * <pre>
3438     * try {
3439     *     FileReader fr = new FileReader("Test.txt");
3440     * } catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
3441     *
3442     * }
3443     * </pre>
3444     *
3445     * <p>parses as:</p>
3446     * <pre>
3447     * LITERAL_TRY -&gt; try
3448     *  |--SLIST -&gt; {
3449     *  |   |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
3450     *  |   |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
3451     *  |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
3452     *  |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; FileReader
3453     *  |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; fr
3454     *  |   |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
3455     *  |   |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3456     *  |   |           `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
3457     *  |   |               |--IDENT -&gt; FileReader
3458     *  |   |               |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3459     *  |   |               |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
3460     *  |   |               |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3461     *  |   |               |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "Test.txt"
3462     *  |   |               `--RPAREN -&gt; )
3463     *  |   |--SEMI -&gt; ;
3464     *  |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3465     *  `--LITERAL_CATCH -&gt; catch
3466     *      |--LPAREN -&gt; (
3467     *      |--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
3468     *      |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
3469     *      |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
3470     *      |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; FileNotFoundException
3471     *      |   `--IDENT -&gt; e
3472     *      |--RPAREN -&gt; )
3473     *      `--SLIST -&gt; {
3474     *          `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3475     * </pre>
3476     *
3477     * @see #LPAREN
3478     * @see #PARAMETER_DEF
3479     * @see #RPAREN
3480     * @see #SLIST
3481     * @see #LITERAL_TRY
3482     **/
3483    public static final int LITERAL_CATCH =
3484        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_CATCH;
3485
3486    /**
3487     * The {@code finally} keyword.
3488     *
3489     * <p>For example:</p>
3490     * <pre>
3491     * try {} finally {}
3492     * </pre>
3493     *
3494     * <p>parses as:</p>
3495     * <pre>
3496     * LITERAL_TRY -&gt; try
3497     *  |--SLIST -&gt; {
3498     *  |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3499     *  `--LITERAL_FINALLY -&gt; finally
3500     *      `--SLIST -&gt; {
3501     *          `--RCURLY -&gt; }
3502     * </pre>
3503     *
3504     * @see #SLIST
3505     * @see #LITERAL_TRY
3506     **/
3507    public static final int LITERAL_FINALLY =
3508        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_FINALLY;
3509
3510    /**
3511     * The {@code +=} (addition assignment) operator.
3512     *
3513     * <p>For example:</p>
3514     * <pre>
3515     * a += b;
3516     * </pre>
3517     *
3518     * <p>parses as:</p>
3519     * <pre>
3520     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
3521     * |   `--PLUS_ASSIGN -&gt; +=
3522     * |       |--IDENT -&gt; a
3523     * |       `--IDENT -&gt; b
3524     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
3525     * </pre>
3526     *
