4435    /**
4436     * The {@code new} keyword.  This element is used to define
4437     * new instances of objects, new arrays, and new anonymous inner
4438     * classes.
4439     *
4440     * <p>For example:</p>
4441     *
4442     * <pre>
4443     * List&lt;String&gt; l = new ArrayList&lt;String&gt;();
4444     * </pre>
4445     *
4446     * <p>parses as:</p>
4447     * <pre>
4448     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
4449     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4450     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
4451     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; List
4452     *  |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
4453     *  |       |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
4454     *  |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
4455     *  |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
4456     *  |       `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
4457     *  |--IDENT -&gt; l
4458     *  |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
4459     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4460     *  |       `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
4461     *  |           |--IDENT -&gt; ArrayList
4462     *  |           |--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
4463     *  |           |   |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
4464     *  |           |   |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
4465     *  |           |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
4466     *  |           |   `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
4467     *  |           |--LPAREN -&gt; (
4468     *  |           |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
4469     *  |           `--RPAREN -&gt; )
4470     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
4471     * </pre>
4472     *
4473     * <p>For example:</p>
4474     * <pre>
4475     * String[] strings = new String[3];
4476     * </pre>
4477     *
4478     * <p>parses as:</p>
4479     * <pre>
4480     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
4481     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4482     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
4483     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; String
4484     *  |   `--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -&gt; [
4485     *  |       `--RBRACK -&gt; ]
4486     *  |--IDENT -&gt; strings
4487     *  |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
4488     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4489     *  |       `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
4490     *  |           |--IDENT -&gt; String
4491     *  |           `--ARRAY_DECLARATOR -&gt; [
4492     *  |               |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4493     *  |               |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 3
4494     *  |               `--RBRACK -&gt; ]
4495     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
4496     * </pre>
4497     *
4498     * <p>For example:</p>
4499     * <pre>
4500     * Supplier&lt;Integer&gt; s = new Supplier&lt;&gt;() {
4501     *     &#064;Override
4502     *     public Integer get() {
4503     *         return 42;
4504     *     }
4505     * };
4506     * </pre>
4507     *
4508     * <p>parses as:</p>
4509     * <pre>
4510     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
4511     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4512     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
4513     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; Supplier
4514     *  |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
4515     *  |       |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
4516     *  |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
4517     *  |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; Integer
4518     *  |       `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
4519     *  |--IDENT -&gt; s
4520     *  |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
4521     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4522     *  |       `--LITERAL_NEW -&gt; new
4523     *  |           |--IDENT -&gt; Supplier
4524     *  |           |--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
4525     *  |           |   |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
4526     *  |           |   `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
4527     *  |           |--LPAREN -&gt; (
4528     *  |           |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
4529     *  |           |--RPAREN -&gt; )
4530     *  |           `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
4531     *  |               |--LCURLY -&gt; {
4532     *  |               |--METHOD_DEF -&gt; METHOD_DEF
4533     *  |               |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4534     *  |               |   |   |--ANNOTATION -&gt; ANNOTATION
4535     *  |               |   |   |   |--AT -&gt; @
4536     *  |               |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; Override
4537     *  |               |   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
4538     *  |               |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
4539     *  |               |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; Integer
4540     *  |               |   |--IDENT -&gt; get
4541     *  |               |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
4542     *  |               |   |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
4543     *  |               |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
4544     *  |               |   `--SLIST -&gt; {
4545     *  |               |       |--LITERAL_RETURN -&gt; return
4546     *  |               |       |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4547     *  |               |       |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 42
4548     *  |               |       |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
4549     *  |               |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
4550     *  |               `--RCURLY -&gt; }
4551     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
4552     * </pre>
4553     *
4554     * @see #IDENT
4555     * @see #DOT
4556     * @see #LPAREN
4557     * @see #ELIST
4558     * @see #RPAREN
4559     * @see #OBJBLOCK
4560     * @see #ARRAY_INIT
4561     * @see FullIdent
4562     **/
4563    public static final int LITERAL_NEW = JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_NEW;

4659     * @see <a
4660     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-3.html#jls-3.10.2">Java
4661     *     Language Specification, &sect;3.10.2</a>
4662     * @see #EXPR
4663     * @see #NUM_DOUBLE
4664     **/
4665    public static final int NUM_FLOAT = JavaLanguageLexer.NUM_FLOAT;
4666    /**
4667     * A long integer literal.  These are almost the same as integer
4668     * literals, but they have an {@code L} or {@code l}
4669     * (ell) suffix.
4670     *
4671     * <p>For example:</p>
4672     * <pre>
4673     * a = 3l;
4674     * </pre>
4675     *
4676     * <p>parses as:</p>
4677     * <pre>
4678     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4679     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
4680     * |       |--IDENT -&gt; a
4681     * |       `--NUM_LONG -&gt; 3l
4682     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
4683     * </pre>
4684     *
4685     * @see <a
4686     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-3.html#jls-3.10.1">Java
4687     *     Language Specification, &sect;3.10.1</a>
4688     * @see #EXPR
4689     * @see #NUM_INT
4690     **/
4691    public static final int NUM_LONG = JavaLanguageLexer.NUM_LONG;
4692    /**
4693     * A double precision floating point literal.  This is a floating
4694     * point number with an optional {@code D} or {@code d}
4695     * suffix.
4696     *
4697     * <p>For example:</p>
4698     * <pre>
4699     * a = 3.14d;
4700     * </pre>
4701     *
4702     * <p>parses as:</p>
4703     * <pre>
4704     * |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4705     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
4706     * |       |--IDENT -&gt; a
4707     * |       `--NUM_DOUBLE -&gt; 3.14d
4708     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
4709     * </pre>
4710     *
4711     * @see <a
4712     *     href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-3.html#jls-3.10.2">Java
4713     *     Language Specification, &sect;3.10.2</a>
4714     * @see #EXPR
4715     * @see #NUM_FLOAT
4716     **/
4717    public static final int NUM_DOUBLE = JavaLanguageLexer.NUM_DOUBLE;
4718
4719    /**
4720     * The {@code assert} keyword.  This is only for Java 1.4 and
4721     * later.
4722     *
4723     * <p>For example:</p>
4724     * <pre>
4725     * assert(x==4);
4726     * </pre>
4727     *
4728     * <p>parses as:</p>
4729     * <pre>
4730     * LITERAL_ASSERT -&gt; assert
4731     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4732     *  |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
4733     *  |   |--EQUAL -&gt; ==
4734     *  |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; x
4735     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 4
4736     *  |   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
4737     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
4738     * </pre>
4739     **/
4740    public static final int LITERAL_ASSERT = JavaLanguageLexer.ASSERT;
4741
4742    /**
4743     * A static import declaration.  Static import declarations are optional,
4744     * but must appear after the package declaration and before the type
4745     * declaration.
4746     *
4747     * <p>For example:</p>
4748     * <pre>
4749     * import static java.io.IOException;
4750     * </pre>
4751     *
4752     * <p>parses as:</p>
4753     * <pre>
4754     * STATIC_IMPORT -&gt; import
4755     * |--LITERAL_STATIC -&gt; static
4756     * |--DOT -&gt; .
4757     * |   |--DOT -&gt; .
4758     * |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; java
4759     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; io
4760     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; IOException
4761     * `--SEMI -&gt; ;
4762     * </pre>
4763     *
4764     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
4765     *     JSR201</a>
4766     * @see #LITERAL_STATIC
4767     * @see #DOT
4768     * @see #IDENT
4769     * @see #STAR
4770     * @see #SEMI
4771     * @see FullIdent
4772     **/
4773    public static final int STATIC_IMPORT =
4774        JavaLanguageLexer.STATIC_IMPORT;
4775
4776    /**
4777     * An enum declaration. Its notable children are
4778     * enum constant declarations followed by
4779     * any construct that may be expected in a class body.
4780     *
4781     * <p>For example:</p>
4782     * <pre>
4783     * public enum MyEnum
4784     *   implements Serializable
4785     * {
4786     *     FIRST_CONSTANT,
4787     *     SECOND_CONSTANT;
4788     *
4789     *     public void someMethod()
4790     *     {
4791     *     }
4792     * }
4793     * </pre>
4794     *
4795     * <p>parses as:</p>
4796     * <pre>
4797     * ENUM_DEF -&gt; ENUM_DEF
4798     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4799     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
4800     *  |--ENUM -&gt; enum
4801     *  |--IDENT -&gt; MyEnum
4802     *  |--IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE -&gt; implements
4803     *  |   `--IDENT -&gt; Serializable
4804     *  `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
4805     *      |--LCURLY -&gt; {
4806     *      |--ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF -&gt; ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF
4807     *      |   |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
4808     *      |   `--IDENT -&gt; FIRST_CONSTANT
4809     *      |--COMMA -&gt; ,
4810     *      |--ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF -&gt; ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF
4811     *      |   |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
4812     *      |   `--IDENT -&gt; SECOND_CONSTANT
4813     *      |--SEMI -&gt; ;
4814     *      |--METHOD_DEF -&gt; METHOD_DEF
4815     *      |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4816     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
4817     *      |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
4818     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_VOID -&gt; void
4819     *      |   |--IDENT -&gt; someMethod
4820     *      |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
4821     *      |   |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
4822     *      |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
4823     *      |   `--SLIST -&gt; {
4824     *      |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
4825     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
4826     * </pre>
4827     *
4828     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
4829     *     JSR201</a>
4830     * @see #MODIFIERS
4831     * @see #ENUM
4832     * @see #IDENT
4833     * @see #EXTENDS_CLAUSE
4834     * @see #IMPLEMENTS_CLAUSE
4835     * @see #OBJBLOCK
4836     * @see #LITERAL_NEW
4837     * @see #ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF
4838     **/
4839    public static final int ENUM_DEF =
4840        JavaLanguageLexer.ENUM_DEF;
4841
4842    /**
4843     * The {@code enum} keyword.  This element appears
4844     * as part of an enum declaration.
4845     *
4846     * <p>For example:</p>
4847     * <pre>
4848     * public enum Count {}
4849     * </pre>
4850     *
4851     * <p>parses as:</p>
4852     * <pre>
4853     * ENUM_DEF -&gt; ENUM_DEF
4854     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4855     *  |  `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
4856     *  |--ENUM -&gt; enum
4857     *  |--IDENT -&gt; Count
4858     *  `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
4859     *      |--LCURLY -&gt; {
4860     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
4861     * </pre>
4862     *
4863     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">JSR201</a>
4864     * @see #MODIFIERS
4865     * @see #ENUM_DEF
4866     * @see #IDENT
4867     * @see #OBJBLOCK
4868     **/
4869    public static final int ENUM =
4870        JavaLanguageLexer.ENUM;
4871
4872    /**
4873     * An enum constant declaration. Its notable children are annotations,
4874     * arguments and object block akin to an anonymous
4875     * inner class' body.
4876     *
4877     * <p>For example:</p>
4878     * <pre>
4879     * SOME_CONSTANT(1)
4880     * {
4881     *     public void someMethodOverriddenFromMainBody()
4882     *     {
4883     *     }
4884     * }
4885     * </pre>
4886     *
4887     * <p>parses as:</p>
4888     * <pre>
4889     * ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF -&gt; ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF
4890     *   |   |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
4891     *   |   |--IDENT -&gt; SOME_CONSTANT
4892     *   |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
4893     *   |   |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
4894     *   |   |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4895     *   |   |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
4896     *   |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
4897     *   |   `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
4898     *   |       |--LCURLY -&gt; {
4899     *   |       |--METHOD_DEF -&gt; METHOD_DEF
4900     *   |       |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4901     *   |       |   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
4902     *   |       |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
4903     *   |       |   |   `--LITERAL_VOID -&gt; void
4904     *   |       |   |--IDENT -&gt; someMethodOverriddenFromMainBody
4905     *   |       |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
4906     *   |       |   |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
4907     *   |       |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
4908     *   |       |   `--SLIST -&gt; {
4909     *   |       |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
4910     *   |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
4911     * </pre>
4912     *
4913     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
4914     *     JSR201</a>
4915     * @see #ANNOTATIONS
4916     * @see #MODIFIERS
4917     * @see #IDENT
4918     * @see #ELIST
4919     * @see #OBJBLOCK
4920     **/
4921    public static final int ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF =
4922        JavaLanguageLexer.ENUM_CONSTANT_DEF;
4923
4924    /**
4925     * A for-each clause.  This is a child of
4926     * {@code LITERAL_FOR}.  The children of this element may be
4927     * a parameter definition, the colon literal and an expression.
4928     *
4929     * <p>For example:</p>
4930     * <pre>
4931     * for (int value : values) {
4932     *     doSomething();
4933     * }
4934     * </pre>
4935     *
4936     * <p>parses as:</p>
4937     * <pre>
4938     * LITERAL_FOR -&gt; for
4939     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
4940     *  |--FOR_EACH_CLAUSE -&gt; FOR_EACH_CLAUSE
4941     *  |   |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
4942     *  |   |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4943     *  |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
4944     *  |   |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
4945     *  |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; value
4946     *  |   |--COLON -&gt; :
4947     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4948     *  |       `--IDENT -&gt; values
4949     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
4950     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
4951     *      |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
4952     *      |   `--METHOD_CALL -&gt; (
4953     *      |       |--IDENT -&gt; doSomething
4954     *      |       |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
4955     *      |       `--RPAREN -&gt; )
4956     *      |--SEMI -&gt; ;
4957     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
4958     * </pre>
4959     *
4960     * @see #VARIABLE_DEF
4961     * @see #ELIST
4962     * @see #LITERAL_FOR
4963     **/
4964    public static final int FOR_EACH_CLAUSE =
4965        JavaLanguageLexer.FOR_EACH_CLAUSE;
4966
4967    /**
4968     * An annotation declaration. The notable children are the name of the
4969     * annotation type, annotation field declarations and (constant) fields.
4970     *
4971     * <p>For example:</p>
4972     * <pre>
4973     * public @interface MyAnnotation
4974     * {
4975     *     int someValue();
4976     * }
4977     * </pre>
4978     *
4979     * <p>parses as:</p>
4980     * <pre>
4981     * ANNOTATION_DEF -&gt; ANNOTATION_DEF
4982     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4983     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
4984     *  |--AT -&gt; @
4985     *  |--LITERAL_INTERFACE -&gt; interface
4986     *  |--IDENT -&gt; MyAnnotation
4987     *  `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
4988     *      |--LCURLY -&gt; {
4989     *      |--ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF -&gt; ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF
4990     *      |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
4991     *      |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
4992     *      |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
4993     *      |   |--IDENT -&gt; someValue
4994     *      |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
4995     *      |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
4996     *      |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
4997     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
4998     * </pre>
4999     *
5000     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
5001     *     JSR201</a>
5002     * @see #MODIFIERS
5003     * @see #LITERAL_INTERFACE
5004     * @see #IDENT
5005     * @see #OBJBLOCK
5006     * @see #ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF
5007     **/
5008    public static final int ANNOTATION_DEF =
5009        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATION_DEF;
5010
5011    /**
5012     * An annotation field declaration.  The notable children are modifiers,
5013     * field type, field name and an optional default value (a conditional
5014     * compile-time constant expression). Default values may also be
5015     * annotations.
5016     *
5017     * <p>For example:</p>
5018     *
5019     * <pre>
5020     *     String someField() default "Hello world";
5021     * </pre>
5022     *
5023     * <p>parses as:</p>
5024     *
5025     * <pre>
5026     * ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF -&gt; ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF
5027     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5028     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5029     *  |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
5030     *  |--IDENT -&gt; someField
5031     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5032     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
5033     *  |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -&gt; default
5034     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
5035     *  |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "Hello world"
5036     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
5037     * </pre>
5038     *
5039     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
5040     *     JSR201</a>
5041     * @see #MODIFIERS
5042     * @see #TYPE
5043     * @see #LITERAL_DEFAULT
5044     */
5045    public static final int ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF =
5046        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATION_FIELD_DEF;
5047
5048    // note: &#064; is the html escape for '@',
5049    // used here to avoid confusing the javadoc tool
5050    /**
5051     * A collection of annotations on a package or enum constant.
5052     * A collections of annotations will only occur on these nodes
5053     * as all other nodes that may be qualified with an annotation can
5054     * be qualified with any other modifier and hence these annotations
5055     * would be contained in a {@link #MODIFIERS} node.
5056     *
5057     * <p>For example:</p>
5058     *
5059     * <pre>
5060     *     &#064;MyAnnotation package blah;
5061     * </pre>
5062     *
5063     * <p>parses as:</p>
5064     *
5065     * <pre>
5066     * PACKAGE_DEF -&gt; package
5067     *  |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
5068     *  |   `--ANNOTATION -&gt; ANNOTATION
5069     *  |       |--AT -&gt; @
5070     *  |       `--IDENT -&gt; MyAnnotation
5071     *  |--IDENT -&gt; blah
5072     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
5073     * </pre>
5074     *
5075     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
5076     *     JSR201</a>
5077     * @see #ANNOTATION
5078     * @see #AT
5079     * @see #IDENT
5080     */
5081    public static final int ANNOTATIONS =
5082        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATIONS;
5083
5084    // note: &#064; is the html escape for '@',
5085    // used here to avoid confusing the javadoc tool
5086    /**
5087     * An annotation of a package, type, field, parameter or variable.
5088     * An annotation may occur anywhere modifiers occur (it is a
5089     * type of modifier) and may also occur prior to a package definition.
5090     * The notable children are: The annotation name and either a single
5091     * default annotation value or a sequence of name value pairs.
5092     * Annotation values may also be annotations themselves.
5093     *
5094     * <p>For example:</p>
5095     * <pre>
5096     *     &#064;MyAnnotation(someField1 = "Hello",
5097     *                    someField2 = &#064;SomeOtherAnnotation)
5098     * </pre>
5099     *
5100     * <p>parses as:</p>
5101     * <pre>
5102     * ANNOTATION -&gt; ANNOTATION
5103     *  |--AT -&gt; @
5104     *  |--IDENT -&gt; MyAnnotation
5105     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5106     *  |--ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR -&gt; ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR
5107     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; someField1
5108     *  |   |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
5109     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
5110     *  |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "Hello"
5111     *  |--COMMA -&gt; ,
5112     *  |--ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR -&gt; ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR
5113     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; someField2
5114     *  |   |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
5115     *  |   `--ANNOTATION -&gt; ANNOTATION
5116     *  |       |--AT -&gt; @
5117     *  |       `--IDENT -&gt; SomeOtherAnnotation
5118     *  `--RPAREN -&gt; )
5119     * </pre>
5120     *
5121     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
5122     *     JSR201</a>
5123     * @see #MODIFIERS
5124     * @see #IDENT
5125     * @see #ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR
5126     */
5127    public static final int ANNOTATION =
5128        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATION;
5129
5130    /**
5131     * An initialization of an annotation member with a value.
5132     * Its children are the name of the member, the assignment literal
5133     * and the (compile-time constant conditional expression) value.
5134     *
5135     * <p>For example:</p>
5136     * <pre>
5137     * &#064;Annotation(
5138     *     value="123"
5139     * )
5140     * </pre>
5141     *
5142     * <p>parses as:</p>
5143     * <pre>
5144     * ANNOTATION -&gt; ANNOTATION
5145     *  |--AT -&gt; &#64;
5146     *  |--IDENT -&gt; Annotation
5147     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5148     *  |--ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR -&gt; ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR
5149     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; value
5150     *  |   |--ASSIGN -&gt; =
5151     *  |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
5152     *  |       `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "123"
5153     *  `--RPAREN -&gt; )
5154     * </pre>
5155     *
5156     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
5157     *     JSR201</a>
5158     * @see #ANNOTATION
5159     * @see #IDENT
5160     */
5161    public static final int ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR =
5162        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR;
5163
5164    /**
5165     * An annotation array member initialization.
5166     * Initializers can not be nested.
5167     * An initializer may be present as a default to an annotation
5168     * member, as the single default value to an annotation
5169     * (e.g. @Annotation({1,2})) or as the value of an annotation
5170     * member value pair.
5171     *
5172     * <p>For example:</p>
5173     * <pre>
5174     * &#64;Annotation({1, 2})
5175     * </pre>
5176     *
5177     * <p>parses as:</p>
5178     * <pre>
5179     * ANNOTATION -&gt; ANNOTATION
5180     *  |--AT -&gt; &#64;
5181     *  |--IDENT -&gt; Annotation
5182     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5183     *  |--ANNOTATION_ARRAY_INIT -&gt; {
5184     *  |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
5185     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
5186     *  |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
5187     *  |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
5188     *  |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 2
5189     *  |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5190     *  `--RPAREN -&gt; )
5191     * </pre>
5192     *
5193     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
5194     *     JSR201</a>
5195     * @see #ANNOTATION
5196     * @see #IDENT
5197     * @see #ANNOTATION_MEMBER_VALUE_PAIR
5198     */
5199    public static final int ANNOTATION_ARRAY_INIT =
5200        JavaLanguageLexer.ANNOTATION_ARRAY_INIT;
5201
5202    /**
5203     * A list of type parameters to a class, interface or
5204     * method definition. Children are LT, at least one
5205     * TYPE_PARAMETER, zero or more of: a COMMAs followed by a single
5206     * TYPE_PARAMETER and a final GT.
5207     *
5208     * <p>For example:</p>
5209     *
5210     * <pre>
5211     * public class MyClass&lt;A, B&gt; {
5212     *
5213     * }
5214     * </pre>
5215     *
5216     * <p>parses as:</p>
5217     *
5218     * <pre>
5219     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
5220     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5221     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
5222     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
5223     * |--IDENT -&gt; MyClass
5224     * |--TYPE_PARAMETERS -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETERS
5225     * |   |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
5226     * |   |--TYPE_PARAMETER -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETER
5227     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; A
5228     * |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
5229     * |   |--TYPE_PARAMETER -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETER
5230     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; B
5231     * |   `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
5232     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
5233     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
5234     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5235     * </pre>
5236     *
5237     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5238     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>
5239     * @see #GENERIC_START
5240     * @see #GENERIC_END
5241     * @see #TYPE_PARAMETER
5242     * @see #COMMA
5243     */
5244    public static final int TYPE_PARAMETERS =
5245        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_PARAMETERS;
5246
5247    /**
5248     * A type parameter to a class, interface or method definition.
5249     * Children are the type name and an optional TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS.
5250     *
5251     * <p>For example:</p>
5252     *
5253     * <pre>
5254     * public class MyClass &lt;A extends Collection&gt; {
5255     *
5256     * }
5257     * </pre>
5258     *
5259     * <p>parses as:</p>
5260     *
5261     * <pre>
5262     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
5263     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5264     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
5265     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
5266     * |--IDENT -&gt; MyClass
5267     * |--TYPE_PARAMETERS -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETERS
5268     * |   |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
5269     * |   |--TYPE_PARAMETER -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETER
5270     * |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; A
5271     * |   |   `--TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS -&gt; extends
5272     * |   |       `--IDENT -&gt; Collection
5273     * |   `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
5274     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
5275     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
5276     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5277     * </pre>
5278     *
5279     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5280     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>
5281     * @see #IDENT
5282     * @see #WILDCARD_TYPE
5283     * @see #TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS
5284     */
5285    public static final int TYPE_PARAMETER =
5286        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_PARAMETER;
5287
5288    /**
5289     * A list of type arguments to a type reference or
5290     * a method/ctor invocation. Children are GENERIC_START, at least one
5291     * TYPE_ARGUMENT, zero or more of a COMMAs followed by a single
5292     * TYPE_ARGUMENT, and a final GENERIC_END.
5293     *
5294     * <p>For example:</p>
5295     *
5296     * <pre>
5297     *     public Collection&lt;?&gt; a;
5298     * </pre>
5299     *
5300     * <p>parses as:</p>
5301     *
5302     * <pre>
5303     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
5304     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5305     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
5306     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5307     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; Collection
5308     *  |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5309     *  |       |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
5310     *  |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
5311     *  |       |   `--WILDCARD_TYPE -&gt; ?
5312     *  |       `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
5313     *  |--IDENT -&gt; a
5314     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
5315     * </pre>
5316     *
5317     * @see #GENERIC_START
5318     * @see #GENERIC_END
5319     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENT
5320     * @see #COMMA
5321     */
5322    public static final int TYPE_ARGUMENTS =
5323        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_ARGUMENTS;
5324
5325    /**
5326     * A type arguments to a type reference or a method/ctor invocation.
5327     * Children are either: type name or wildcard type with possible type
5328     * upper or lower bounds.
5329     *
5330     * <p>For example: {@code List< ? super List> list }</p>
5331     *
5332     * <p>parses as:</p>
5333     * <pre>
5334     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
5335     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5336     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5337     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; List
5338     *  |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5339     *  |       |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
5340     *  |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
5341     *  |       |   |--WILDCARD_TYPE -&gt; ?
5342     *  |       |   `--TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS -&gt; super
5343     *  |       |       `--IDENT -&gt; List
5344     *  |       `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
5345     *  |--IDENT -&gt; list
5346     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
5347     * </pre>
5348     *
5349     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5350     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>
5351     * @see #WILDCARD_TYPE
5352     * @see #TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS
5353     * @see #TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS
5354     */
5355    public static final int TYPE_ARGUMENT =
5356        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_ARGUMENT;
5357
5358    /**
5359     * The type that refers to all types. This node has no children.
5360     *
5361     * <p>For example: </p>
5362     * <pre>
5363     *
5364     * List&lt;?&gt; list;
5365     * </pre>
5366     *
5367     * <p>parses as:</p>
5368     * <pre>
5369     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
5370     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5371     * |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5372     * |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; List
5373     * |   |   |`--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5374     * |   |        |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
5375     * |   |        |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
5376     * |   |        |  `--WILDCARD_TYPE -&gt; ?
5377     * |   |        `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
5378     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; list
5379     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
5380     * </pre>
5381     *
5382     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5383     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>
5384     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENT
5385     * @see #TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS
5386     * @see #TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS
5387     */
5388    public static final int WILDCARD_TYPE =
5389        JavaLanguageLexer.WILDCARD_TYPE;
5390
5391    /**
5392     * An upper bounds on a wildcard type argument or type parameter.
5393     * This node has one child - the type that is being used for
5394     * the bounding.
5395     *
5396     * <p>For example: {@code List< ? extends Number> list;}</p>
5397     *
5398     * <p>parses as:</p>
5399     * <pre>
5400     * --VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
5401     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5402     *  |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5403     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; List
5404     *  |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5405     *  |       |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
5406     *  |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
5407     *  |       |   |--WILDCARD_TYPE -&gt; ?
5408     *  |       |   `--TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS -&gt; extends
5409     *  |       |       `--IDENT -&gt; Number
5410     *  |       `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
5411     *  |--IDENT -&gt; list
5412     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
5413     *  </pre>
5414     *
5415     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5416     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>
5417     * @see #TYPE_PARAMETER
5418     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENT
5419     * @see #WILDCARD_TYPE
5420     */
5421    public static final int TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS =
5422        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS;
5423
5424    /**
5425     * A lower bounds on a wildcard type argument. This node has one child
5426     *  - the type that is being used for the bounding.
5427     *
5428     *  <p>For example: {@code List< ? super Integer> list;}</p>
5429     *
5430     *  <p>parses as:</p>
5431     *  <pre>
5432     *  --VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
5433     *     |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5434     *     |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5435     *     |   |--IDENT -&gt; List
5436     *     |   `--TYPE_ARGUMENTS -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENTS
5437     *     |       |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
5438     *     |       |--TYPE_ARGUMENT -&gt; TYPE_ARGUMENT
5439     *     |       |   |--WILDCARD_TYPE -&gt; ?
5440     *     |       |   `--TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS -&gt; super
5441     *     |       |       `--IDENT -&gt; Integer
5442     *     |       `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
5443     *     |--IDENT -&gt; list
5444     *     `--SEMI -&gt; ;
5445     *  </pre>
5446     *
5447     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se11/html/jls-8.html#jls-8.1.2">
5448     *     Generic Classes and Type Parameters</a>
5449     * @see #TYPE_ARGUMENT
5450     * @see #WILDCARD_TYPE
5451     */
5452    public static final int TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS =
5453        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_LOWER_BOUNDS;
5454
5455    /**
5456     * An {@code @} symbol - signifying an annotation instance or the prefix
5457     * to the interface literal signifying the definition of an annotation
5458     * declaration.
5459     *
5460     * <p>For example:</p>
5461     * <pre>
5462     * &#64;Deprecated
5463     * private int value;
5464     * </pre>
5465     *
5466     * <p>parses as:</p>
5467     * <pre>
5468     * VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
5469     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5470     * |  |--ANNOTATION -&gt; ANNOTATION
5471     * |  |  |--AT -&gt; &#64;
5472     * |  |  `--IDENT -&gt; Deprecated
5473     * |  `--LITERAL_PRIVATE -&gt; private
5474     * |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5475     * |  `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
5476     * |--IDENT -&gt; value
5477     * `--SEMI -&gt; ;
5478     * </pre>

5481     *     JSR201</a>

5485    /**
5486     * A triple dot for variable-length parameters. This token only ever occurs
5487     * in a parameter declaration immediately after the type of the parameter.
5488     *
5489     * <p>For example:</p>
5490     * <pre>
5491     *  public void myShape(int... dimension) {
5492     *
5493     *  }
5494     * </pre>

5497     * <pre>
5498     * METHOD_DEF -&gt; METHOD_DEF

5500     *   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
5501     *   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5502     *   |   `--LITERAL_VOID -&gt; void
5503     *   |--IDENT -&gt; myShape
5504     *   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5505     *   |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
5506     *   |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
5507     *   |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5508     *   |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5509     *   |       |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
5510     *   |       |--ELLIPSIS -&gt; ...
5511     *   |       `--IDENT -&gt; dimension
5512     *   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
5513     *   `--SLIST -&gt; {
5514     *       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5515     * </pre>
5516     *
5517     * @see <a href="https://www.jcp.org/en/jsr/detail?id=201">
5518     *     JSR201</a>
5519     */

5522    /**
5523     * The {@code &} symbol when used to extend a generic upper or lower bounds constrain
5524     * or a type cast expression with an additional interface.
5525     *
5526     * <p>Generic type bounds extension:
5527     * {@code class Comparable<T extends Serializable & CharSequence>}</p>
5528     * <pre>
5529     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
5530     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5531     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
5532     * |--IDENT -&gt; Comparable
5533     * |--TYPE_PARAMETERS -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETERS
5534     *     |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
5535     *     |--TYPE_PARAMETER -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETER
5536     *     |   |--IDENT -&gt; T
5537     *     |   `--TYPE_UPPER_BOUNDS -&gt; extends
5538     *     |       |--IDENT -&gt; Serializable
5539     *     |       |--TYPE_EXTENSION_AND -&gt; &#38;
5540     *     |       `--IDENT -&gt; CharSequence
5541     *     `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;

5547     * --LITERAL_RETURN -&gt; return

5550     *    |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5551     *    |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; Serializable
5552     *    |       |--TYPE_EXTENSION_AND -&gt; &#38;
5553     *    |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5554     *    |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; CharSequence
5555     *    |       |--RPAREN -&gt; )
5556     *    |       `--LITERAL_NULL -&gt; null
5557     *    `--SEMI -&gt; ;
5558     * </pre>
5559     *
5560     * @see #EXTENDS_CLAUSE
5561     * @see #TYPECAST
5562     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-4.html#jls-4.4">
5563     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;4.4</a>
5564     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se8/html/jls-15.html#jls-15.16">
5565     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;15.16</a>
5566     */
5567    public static final int TYPE_EXTENSION_AND =
5568        JavaLanguageLexer.TYPE_EXTENSION_AND;
5569
5570    /**
5571     * A {@code <} symbol signifying the start of type arguments or type parameters.

5573     * <p>For example:</p>
5574     * <pre>
5575     * class Test&lt;T&gt; {}

5578     * <p>parses as:</p>
5579     * <pre>
5580     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF

5583     *  |--IDENT -&gt; Test
5584     *  |--TYPE_PARAMETERS -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETERS

5586     *  |   |--TYPE_PARAMETER -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETER
5587     *  |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; T
5588     *  |   `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
5589     *  `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
5590     *      |--LCURLY -&gt; {
5591     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5592     * </pre>
5593     *
5594     * @see #MODIFIERS
5595     * @see #IDENT
5596     * @see #OBJBLOCK
5597     * @see #TYPE_PARAMETERS
5598     * @see #GENERIC_END
5599     */
5600    public static final int GENERIC_START =
5601        JavaLanguageLexer.GENERIC_START;
5602
5603    /**
5604     * A {@code >} symbol signifying the end of type arguments or type parameters.
5605     *
5606     * <p>For example:</p>
5607     * <pre>
5608     * class Test&lt;T&gt; {}
5609     * </pre>
5610     *
5611     * <p>parses as:</p>
5612     * <pre>
5613     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
5614     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5615     *  |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
5616     *  |--IDENT -&gt; Test
5617     *  |--TYPE_PARAMETERS -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETERS
5618     *  |   |--GENERIC_START -&gt; &lt;
5619     *  |   |--TYPE_PARAMETER -&gt; TYPE_PARAMETER
5620     *  |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; T
5621     *  |   `--GENERIC_END -&gt; &gt;
5622     *  `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
5623     *      |--LCURLY -&gt; {
5624     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5625     * </pre>
5626     *
5627     * @see #MODIFIERS
5628     * @see #IDENT
5629     * @see #OBJBLOCK
5630     * @see #TYPE_PARAMETERS
5631     * @see #GENERIC_START
5632     */
5633    public static final int GENERIC_END = JavaLanguageLexer.GENERIC_END;

5635    /**
5636     * Special lambda symbol {@code ->}.
5637     *
5638     * <p>For example:</p>
5639     * <pre>
5640     * numbers.forEach((n) -&gt; System.out.println(n));
5641     * </pre>
5642     *

5644     * <pre>
5645     * METHOD_CALL -&gt; (
5646     *  |--DOT -&gt; .
5647     *  |   |--IDENT -&gt; numbers
5648     *  |   `--IDENT -&gt; forEach

5651     *  |       |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5652     *  |       |--PARAMETERS -&gt; PARAMETERS
5653     *  |       |   `--PARAMETER_DEF -&gt; PARAMETER_DEF
5654     *  |       |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5655     *  |       |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5656     *  |       |       `--IDENT -&gt; n
5657     *  |       |--RPAREN -&gt; )
5658     *  |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
5659     *  |           `--METHOD_CALL -&gt; (
5660     *  |               |--DOT -&gt; .
5661     *  |               |   |--DOT -&gt; .
5662     *  |               |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; System
5663     *  |               |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; out
5664     *  |               |   `--IDENT -&gt; println
5665     *  |               |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
5666     *  |               |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
5667     *  |               |       `--IDENT -&gt; n
5668     *  |               `--RPAREN -&gt; )
5669     *  `--RPAREN -&gt; )
5670     * </pre>
5671     *
5672     */

5707     * <pre>
5708     * --BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN -&gt; /&#42;
5709     *    |--COMMENT_CONTENT -&gt;  Comment content\r\n

5722     * </pre>

5724     * <p>parses as:</p>
5725     * <pre>
5726     * BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN -&gt; /&#42;
5727     *  |--COMMENT_CONTENT -&gt; comment

5742     * /&#42;

5745     * </pre>

5751     * |--BLOCK_COMMENT_BEGIN -&gt; /&#42;
5752     * |   |--COMMENT_CONTENT -&gt; \n\t\t\tthis is multiline comment\n\t\t

5760    /**
5761     * A pattern variable definition; when conditionally matched,
5762     * this variable is assigned with the defined type.
5763     *
5764     * <p>For example:</p>
5765     * <pre>
5766     * if (obj instanceof String str) { }
5767     * </pre>
5768     *
5769     * <p>parses as:</p>
5770     * <pre>
5771     * LITERAL_IF -&gt; if
5772     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5773     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
5774     *  |   `--LITERAL_INSTANCEOF -&gt; instanceof
5775     *  |       |--IDENT -&gt; obj
5776     *  |       `--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
5777     *  |           |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5778     *  |           |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
5779     *  |           `--IDENT -&gt; str
5780     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
5781     *  `--SLIST -&gt; {
5782     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5783     * </pre>
5784     *
5785     * @see #LITERAL_INSTANCEOF
5786     * @since 8.35
5787     */
5788    public static final int PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF =
5789            JavaLanguageLexer.PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF;
5790
5791    /**
5792     * The {@code record} keyword.  This element appears
5793     * as part of a record declaration.
5794     *
5795     * <p>For example:</p>
5796     * <pre>
5797     * public record MyRecord () {
5798     *
5799     * }
5800     * </pre>
5801     *
5802     * <p>parses as:</p>
5803     * <pre>
5804     * RECORD_DEF -&gt; RECORD_DEF
5805     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5806     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
5807     * |--LITERAL_RECORD -&gt; record
5808     * |--IDENT -&gt; MyRecord
5809     * |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5810     * |--RECORD_COMPONENTS -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENTS
5811     * |--RPAREN -&gt; )
5812     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
5813     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
5814     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5815     * </pre>
5816     *
5817     * @since 8.35
5818     **/
5819    public static final int LITERAL_RECORD =
5820            JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_RECORD;
5821
5822    /**
5823     * A declaration of a record specifies a name, a header, and a body.
5824     * The header lists the components of the record, which are the variables
5825     * that make up its state.
5826     *
5827     * <p>For example:</p>
5828     * <pre>
5829     * public record MyRecord () {
5830     *
5831     * }
5832     * </pre>
5833     *
5834     * <p>parses as:</p>
5835     * <pre>
5836     * RECORD_DEF -&gt; RECORD_DEF
5837     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5838     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
5839     * |--LITERAL_RECORD -&gt; record
5840     * |--IDENT -&gt; MyRecord
5841     * |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5842     * |--RECORD_COMPONENTS -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENTS
5843     * |--RPAREN -&gt; )
5844     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
5845     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
5846     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5847     * </pre>
5848     *
5849     * @since 8.35
5850     */
5851    public static final int RECORD_DEF =
5852            JavaLanguageLexer.RECORD_DEF;
5853
5854    /**
5855     * Record components are a (possibly empty) list containing the components of a record, which
5856     * are the variables that make up its state.
5857     *
5858     * <p>For example:</p>
5859     * <pre>
5860     * public record myRecord (Comp x, Comp y) { }
5861     * </pre>
5862     *
5863     * <p>parses as:</p>
5864     * <pre>
5865     * RECORD_DEF -&gt; RECORD_DEF
5866     *  |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5867     *  |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
5868     *  |--LITERAL_RECORD -&gt; record
5869     *  |--IDENT -&gt; myRecord
5870     *  |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5871     *  |--RECORD_COMPONENTS -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENTS
5872     *  |   |--RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF
5873     *  |   |   |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
5874     *  |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5875     *  |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; Comp
5876     *  |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; x
5877     *  |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
5878     *  |   `--RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF
5879     *  |       |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
5880     *  |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5881     *  |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; Comp
5882     *  |       `--IDENT -&gt; y
5883     *  |--RPAREN -&gt; )
5884     *  `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
5885     *      |--LCURLY -&gt; {
5886     *      `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5887     * </pre>
5888     *
5889     * @since 8.36
5890     */
5891    public static final int RECORD_COMPONENTS =
5892            JavaLanguageLexer.RECORD_COMPONENTS;
5893
5894    /**
5895     * A record component is a variable that comprises the state of a record.  Record components
5896     * have annotations (possibly), a type definition, and an identifier.  They can also be of
5897     * variable arity ('...').
5898     *
5899     * <p>For example:</p>
5900     * <pre>
5901     * public record MyRecord(Comp x, Comp... comps) {
5902     *
5903     * }
5904     * </pre>
5905     *
5906     * <p>parses as:</p>
5907     * <pre>
5908     * RECORD_DEF -&gt; RECORD_DEF
5909     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5910     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
5911     * |--LITERAL_RECORD -&gt; record
5912     * |--IDENT -&gt; MyRecord
5913     * |--LPAREN -&gt; (
5914     * |--RECORD_COMPONENTS -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENTS
5915     * |   |--RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF
5916     * |   |   |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
5917     * |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5918     * |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; Comp
5919     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; x
5920     * |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
5921     * |   `--RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF
5922     * |       |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
5923     * |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5924     * |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; Comp
5925     * |       |--ELLIPSIS -&gt; ...
5926     * |       `--IDENT -&gt; comps
5927     * |--RPAREN -&gt; )
5928     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
5929     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
5930     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
5931     * </pre>
5932     *
5933     * @since 8.36
5934     */
5935    public static final int RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF =
5936            JavaLanguageLexer.RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF;
5937
5938    /**
5939     * A compact canonical constructor eliminates the list of formal parameters; they are
5940     * declared implicitly.
5941     *
5942     * <p>For example:</p>
5943     * <pre>
5944     * public record myRecord () {
5945     *     public myRecord{}
5946     * }
5947     * </pre>
5948     *
5949     * <p>parses as:</p>
5950     * <pre>
5951     * RECORD_DEF
5952     * |--MODIFIERS
5953     * |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC (public)
5954     * |--LITERAL_RECORD (record)
5955     * |--IDENT (myRecord)
5956     * |--LPAREN (()
5957     * |--RECORD_COMPONENTS
5958     * |--RPAREN ())
5959     * `--OBJBLOCK
5960     *     |--LCURLY ({)
5961     *     |--COMPACT_CTOR_DEF
5962     *     |   |--MODIFIERS
5963     *     |   |   `--LITERAL_PUBLIC (public)
5964     *     |   |--IDENT (myRecord)
5965     *     |   `--SLIST ({)
5966     *     |       `--RCURLY (})
5967     *     `--RCURLY (})
5968     * </pre>
5969     *
5970     * @since 8.36
5971     */
5972    public static final int COMPACT_CTOR_DEF =
5973            JavaLanguageLexer.COMPACT_CTOR_DEF;
5974
5975    /**
5976     * Text blocks are a new feature added to to Java SE 15 and later
5977     * that will make writing multi-line strings much easier and cleaner.
5978     * Beginning of a Java 15 Text Block literal,
5979     * delimited by three double quotes.
5980     *
5981     * <p>For example:</p>
5982     * <pre>
5983     *         String hello = """
5984     *                 Hello, world!
5985     *                 """;
5986     * </pre>
5987     *
5988     * <p>parses as:</p>
5989     * <pre>
5990     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
5991     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
5992     * |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
5993     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
5994     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; hello
5995     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
5996     * |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
5997     * |           `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN -&gt; """
5998     * |               |--TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT -&gt; \n                Hello, world!\n
5999     * |               `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END -&gt; """
6000     * `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6001     * </pre>
6002     *
6003     * @since 8.36
6004     */
6005    public static final int TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN =
6006            JavaLanguageLexer.TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN;
6007
6008    /**
6009     * Content of a Java 15 text block. This is a
6010     * sequence of characters, possibly escaped with '\'. Actual line terminators
6011     * are represented by '\n'.
6012     *
6013     * <p>For example:</p>
6014     * <pre>
6015     *         String hello = """
6016     *                 Hello, world!
6017     *                 """;
6018     * </pre>
6019     *
6020     * <p>parses as:</p>
6021     * <pre>
6022     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
6023     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6024     * |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6025     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
6026     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; hello
6027     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
6028     * |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6029     * |           `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN -&gt; """
6030     * |               |--TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT -&gt; \n                Hello, world!\n
6031     * |               `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END -&gt; """
6032     * `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6033     * </pre>
6034     *
6035     * @since 8.36
6036     */
6037    public static final int TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT =
6038            JavaLanguageLexer.TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT;
6039
6040    /**
6041     * End of a Java 15 text block literal, delimited by three
6042     * double quotes.
6043     *
6044     * <p>For example:</p>
6045     * <pre>
6046     *         String hello = """
6047     *                 Hello, world!
6048     *                 """;
6049     * </pre>
6050     *
6051     * <p>parses as:</p>
6052     * <pre>
6053     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
6054     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6055     * |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6056     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
6057     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; hello
6058     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
6059     * |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6060     * |           `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_BEGIN -&gt; """
6061     * |               |--TEXT_BLOCK_CONTENT -&gt; \n                Hello, world!\n
6062     * |               `--TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END -&gt; """
6063     * `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6064     * </pre>
6065     *
6066     * @since 8.36
6067     */
6068    public static final int TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END =
6069            JavaLanguageLexer.TEXT_BLOCK_LITERAL_END;
6070
6071    /**
6072     * The {@code yield} keyword.  This element appears
6073     * as part of a yield statement.
6074     *
6075     * <p>For example:</p>
6076     * <pre>
6077     * int yield = 0; // not a keyword here
6078     * return switch (mode) {
6079     *    case "a", "b":
6080     *        yield 1;
6081     *    default:
6082     *        yield - 1;
6083     * };
6084     * </pre>
6085     *
6086     * <p>parses as:</p>
6087     * <pre>
6088     * |--VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; VARIABLE_DEF
6089     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6090     * |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6091     * |   |   `--LITERAL_INT -&gt; int
6092     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; yield
6093     * |   `--ASSIGN -&gt; =
6094     * |       `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6095     * |           `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
6096     * |--SEMI -&gt; ;
6097     * |--LITERAL_RETURN -&gt; return
6098     * |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6099     * |   |   `--LITERAL_SWITCH -&gt; switch
6100     * |   |       |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6101     * |   |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6102     * |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; mode
6103     * |   |       |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6104     * |   |       |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6105     * |   |       |--CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
6106     * |   |       |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
6107     * |   |       |   |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6108     * |   |       |   |   |   `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "a"
6109     * |   |       |   |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
6110     * |   |       |   |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6111     * |   |       |   |   |   `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "b"
6112     * |   |       |   |   `--COLON -&gt; :
6113     * |   |       |   `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
6114     * |   |       |       `--LITERAL_YIELD -&gt; yield
6115     * |   |       |           |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6116     * |   |       |           |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
6117     * |   |       |           `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6118     * |   |       |--CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
6119     * |   |       |   |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -&gt; default
6120     * |   |       |   |   `--COLON -&gt; :
6121     * |   |       |   `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
6122     * |   |       |       `--LITERAL_YIELD -&gt; yield
6123     * |   |       |           |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6124     * |   |       |           |   `--UNARY_MINUS -&gt; -
6125     * |   |       |           |       `--NUM_INT -&gt; 1
6126     * |   |       |           `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6127     * |   |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6128     * |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6129     * </pre>
6130     *
6131     *
6132     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
6133     * @see #CASE_GROUP
6134     * @see #SLIST
6135     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
6136     *
6137     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se13/preview/switch-expressions.html">
6138     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;14.21</a>
6139     *
6140     * @since 8.36
6141     */
6142    public static final int LITERAL_YIELD =
6143            JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_YIELD;
6144
6145    /**
6146     * Switch Expressions.
6147     *
6148     * <p>For example:</p>
6149     * <pre>
6150     * return switch (day) {
6151     *     case SAT, SUN -&gt; "Weekend";
6152     *     default -&gt; "Working day";
6153     * };
6154     * </pre>
6155     *
6156     * <p>parses as:</p>
6157     * <pre>
6158     * LITERAL_RETURN -&gt; return
6159     *  |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6160     *  |   `--LITERAL_SWITCH -&gt; switch
6161     *  |       |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6162     *  |       |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6163     *  |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; day
6164     *  |       |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6165     *  |       |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6166     *  |       |--SWITCH_RULE -&gt; SWITCH_RULE
6167     *  |       |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
6168     *  |       |   |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6169     *  |       |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; SAT
6170     *  |       |   |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
6171     *  |       |   |   `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6172     *  |       |   |       `--IDENT -&gt; SUN
6173     *  |       |   |--LAMBDA -&gt; -&gt;
6174     *  |       |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6175     *  |       |   |   `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "Weekend"
6176     *  |       |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6177     *  |       |--SWITCH_RULE -&gt; SWITCH_RULE
6178     *  |       |   |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -&gt; default
6179     *  |       |   |--LAMBDA -&gt; -&gt;
6180     *  |       |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6181     *  |       |   |   `--STRING_LITERAL -&gt; "Working day"
6182     *  |       |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6183     *  |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6184     *  `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6185     * </pre>
6186     *
6187     * @see #LITERAL_CASE
6188     * @see #LITERAL_DEFAULT
6189     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
6190     * @see #LITERAL_YIELD
6191     *
6192     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se13/preview/switch-expressions.html">
6193     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;14.21</a>
6194     *
6195     * @since 8.36
6196     */
6197    public static final int SWITCH_RULE =
6198            JavaLanguageLexer.SWITCH_RULE;
6199
6200    /**
6201     * The {@code non-sealed} keyword.  This element appears
6202     * as part of a class or interface declaration.
6203     *
6204     * <p>For example:</p>
6205     * <pre>
6206     * non-sealed class Square extends Rectangle { }
6207     * </pre>
6208     *

6210     * <pre>
6211     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF

6214     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
6215     * |--IDENT -&gt; Square
6216     * |--EXTENDS_CLAUSE -&gt; extends
6217     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; Rectangle
6218     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
6219     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6220     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6221     * </pre>
6222     *
6223     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/15/docs/specs/sealed-classes-jls.html">
6224     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;8.1.1.2</a>
6225     * @see #MODIFIERS
6226     *
6227     * @since 8.42
6228     */
6229    public static final int LITERAL_NON_SEALED =
6230        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_NON_SEALED;
6231
6232    /**
6233     * The {@code sealed} restricted identifier.  This element appears
6234     * as part of a class or interface declaration.
6235     *
6236     * <p>For example:</p>
6237     * <pre>
6238     * public sealed class Shape permits Circle, Square, Rectangle { }
6239     * </pre>
6240     *

6242     * <pre>
6243     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
6244     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6245     * |   |--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
6246     * |   `--LITERAL_SEALED -&gt; sealed
6247     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
6248     * |--IDENT -&gt; Shape
6249     * |--PERMITS_CLAUSE -&gt; permits
6250     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; Circle
6251     * |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
6252     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; Square
6253     * |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
6254     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; Rectangle
6255     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
6256     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6257     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6258     * </pre>

6260     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/15/docs/specs/sealed-classes-jls.html">
6261     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;8.1.1.2</a>
6262     * @see #MODIFIERS
6263     *
6264     * @since 8.42
6265     */
6266    public static final int LITERAL_SEALED =
6267        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_SEALED;
6268
6269    /**
6270     * The {@code permits} restricted identifier.  This element appears
6271     * as part of a class or interface declaration.
6272     *
6273     * <p>For example:</p>
6274     * <pre>
6275     * public sealed class Shape permits Circle, Square, Rectangle { }
6276     * </pre>
6277     *
6278     * <p>parses as:</p>
6279     * <pre>
6280     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
6281     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6282     * |   |--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
6283     * |   `--LITERAL_SEALED -&gt; sealed
6284     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
6285     * |--IDENT -&gt; Shape
6286     * |--PERMITS_CLAUSE -&gt; permits
6287     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; Circle
6288     * |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
6289     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; Square
6290     * |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
6291     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; Rectangle
6292     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
6293     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6294     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6295     * </pre>
6296     *
6297     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/15/docs/specs/sealed-classes-jls.html">
6298     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;9.1.4</a>
6299     * @see #MODIFIERS
6300     *
6301     * @since 8.42
6302     */
6303    public static final int LITERAL_PERMITS =
6304        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_PERMITS;
6305
6306    /**
6307     * A permits clause.  A permits clause's children are a comma separated list of one or
6308     * more identifiers.
6309     *
6310     * <p>For example:</p>
6311     * <pre>
6312     * public sealed class Shape permits Circle, Square, Rectangle { }
6313     * </pre>
6314     *
6315     * <p>parses as:</p>
6316     * <pre>
6317     * CLASS_DEF -&gt; CLASS_DEF
6318     * |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6319     * |   |--LITERAL_PUBLIC -&gt; public
6320     * |   `--LITERAL_SEALED -&gt; sealed
6321     * |--LITERAL_CLASS -&gt; class
6322     * |--IDENT -&gt; Shape
6323     * |--PERMITS_CLAUSE -&gt; permits
6324     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; Circle
6325     * |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
6326     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; Square
6327     * |   |--COMMA -&gt; ,
6328     * |   `--IDENT -&gt; Rectangle
6329     * `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
6330     *     |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6331     *     `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6332     * </pre>
6333     *
6334     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/en/java/javase/15/docs/specs/sealed-classes-jls.html">
6335     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;9.1.4</a>
6336     * @see #MODIFIERS
6337     * @see #CLASS_DEF
6338     * @see #INTERFACE_DEF
6339     * @see #COMMA
6340     * @see #IDENT
6341     *
6342     * @since 8.42
6343     */

6345        JavaLanguageLexer.PERMITS_CLAUSE;

6347    /**
6348     * A pattern definition, excluding simple type pattern (pattern variable)
6349     * definition such as {@code if (o instanceof Integer i){}}. Pattern definitions
6350     * appear as operands of statements and expressions.
6351     *
6352     * <p>For example:</p>
6353     * <pre>
6354     * switch(o) {
6355     *     case String s when s.length() &gt; 4: // guarded pattern, `PATTERN_DEF`
6356     *         break;
6357     *     case String s: // type pattern, no `PATTERN_DEF`
6358     *         break;
6359     * }
6360     * </pre>
6361     *
6362     * <p>parses as:</p>
6363     * <pre>
6364     * LITERAL_SWITCH -&gt; switch
6365     * |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6366     * |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6367     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; o
6368     * |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6369     * |   |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6370     * |   |--CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
6371     * |   |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
6372     * |   |   |   |--PATTERN_DEF -&gt; PATTERN_DEF
6373     * |   |   |   |   `--LITERAL_WHEN -&gt; when
6374     * |   |   |   |       |--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6375     * |   |   |   |       |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6376     * |   |   |   |       |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6377     * |   |   |   |       |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
6378     * |   |   |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; s
6379     * |   |   |   |       `--GT -&gt; &gt;
6380     * |   |   |   |           |--METHOD_CALL -&gt; (
6381     * |   |   |   |           |   |--DOT -&gt; .
6382     * |   |   |   |           |   |   |--IDENT -&gt; s
6383     * |   |   |   |           |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; length
6384     * |   |   |   |           |   |--ELIST -&gt; ELIST
6385     * |   |   |   |           |   `--RPAREN -&gt; )
6386     * |   |   |   |           `--NUM_INT -&gt; 4
6387     * |   |   |   `--COLON -&gt; :
6388     * |   |   `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
6389     * |   |       `--LITERAL_BREAK -&gt; break
6390     * |   |           `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6391     * |   |--CASE_GROUP -&gt; CASE_GROUP
6392     * |   |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
6393     * |   |   |   |--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6394     * |   |   |   |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6395     * |   |   |   |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6396     * |   |   |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
6397     * |   |   |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; s
6398     * |   |   |   `--COLON -&gt; :
6399     * |   |   `--SLIST -&gt; SLIST
6400     * |   |       `--LITERAL_BREAK -&gt; break
6401     * |   |           `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6402     * |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6403     * `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6404     * </pre>
6405     *
6406     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se17/html/jls-14.html#jls-14.30">
6407     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;14.30</a>
6408     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
6409     * @see #PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6410     * @see #LITERAL_INSTANCEOF
6411     *
6412     * @since 9.3
6413     */
6414    public static final int PATTERN_DEF =
6415        JavaLanguageLexer.PATTERN_DEF;

6417    /**
6418     * A {@code when} clause. Appears as part of a switch label in a guarded pattern definition.
6419     *
6420     * <p>For example:</p>
6421     * <pre>
6422     * return switch (o) {
6423     *     case Integer i when i &gt;= 0 -&gt; i;
6424     *     default -&gt; 2;
6425     * };
6426     * </pre>
6427     *
6428     * <p>parses as:</p>
6429     * <pre>
6430     * LITERAL_RETURN -&gt; return
6431     *  `--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6432     *      `--LITERAL_SWITCH -&gt; switch
6433     *          |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6434     *          |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6435     *          |   `--IDENT -&gt; o
6436     *          |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6437     *          |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6438     *          |--SWITCH_RULE -&gt; SWITCH_RULE
6439     *          |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
6440     *          |   |   `--PATTERN_DEF -&gt; PATTERN_DEF
6441     *          |   |       `--LITERAL_WHEN -&gt; when
6442     *          |   |           |--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6443     *          |   |           |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6444     *          |   |           |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6445     *          |   |           |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; Integer
6446     *          |   |           |   `--IDENT -&gt; i
6447     *          |   |           `--GE -&gt; &gt;=
6448     *          |   |               |--IDENT -&gt; i
6449     *          |   |               `--NUM_INT -&gt; 0
6450     *          |   |--LAMBDA -&gt; -&gt;
6451     *          |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6452     *          |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; i
6453     *          |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6454     *          |--SWITCH_RULE -&gt; SWITCH_RULE
6455     *          |   |--LITERAL_DEFAULT -&gt; default
6456     *          |   |--LAMBDA -&gt; -&gt;
6457     *          |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6458     *          |   |   `--NUM_INT -&gt; 2
6459     *          |   `--SEMI -&gt; ;
6460     *          `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6461     * </pre>
6462     *
6463     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se17/html/jls-14.html#jls-14.30">
6464     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;14.30</a>
6465     * @see #LITERAL_SWITCH
6466     * @see #PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6467     * @see #LITERAL_INSTANCEOF
6468     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
6469     *
6470     * @since 10.7.0
6471     */
6472    public static final int LITERAL_WHEN =
6473        JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_WHEN;

6475    /**
6476     * A {@code record} pattern definition. A record pattern consists of a type,
6477     * a (possibly empty) record component pattern list which is used to match against
6478     * the corresponding record components, and an optional identifier. Appears as part of
6479     * an {@code instanceof} expression or a {@code case} label in a switch.
6480     *
6481     * <p>For example:</p>
6482     * <pre>
6483     * record R(Object o){}
6484     * if (o instanceof R(String s) myRecord) {}
6485     * switch (o) {
6486     *     case R(String s) myRecord -&gt; {}
6487     * }
6488     * </pre>
6489     *
6490     * <p>parses as:</p>
6491     * <pre>
6492     * |--RECORD_DEF -&gt; RECORD_DEF
6493     * |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6494     * |   |--LITERAL_RECORD -&gt; record
6495     * |   |--IDENT -&gt; R
6496     * |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6497     * |   |--RECORD_COMPONENTS -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENTS
6498     * |   |   `--RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF -&gt; RECORD_COMPONENT_DEF
6499     * |   |       |--ANNOTATIONS -&gt; ANNOTATIONS
6500     * |   |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6501     * |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; Object
6502     * |   |       `--IDENT -&gt; o
6503     * |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6504     * |   `--OBJBLOCK -&gt; OBJBLOCK
6505     * |       |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6506     * |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6507     * |--LITERAL_IF -&gt; if
6508     * |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6509     * |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6510     * |   |   `--LITERAL_INSTANCEOF -&gt; instanceof
6511     * |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; o
6512     * |   |       `--RECORD_PATTERN_DEF -&gt; RECORD_PATTERN_DEF
6513     * |   |           |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6514     * |   |           |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6515     * |   |           |   `--IDENT -&gt; R
6516     * |   |           |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6517     * |   |           |--RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS -&gt; RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS
6518     * |   |           |   `--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6519     * |   |           |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6520     * |   |           |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6521     * |   |           |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
6522     * |   |           |       `--IDENT -&gt; s
6523     * |   |           |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6524     * |   |           `--IDENT -&gt; myRecord
6525     * |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6526     * |   `--SLIST -&gt; {
6527     * |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6528     * |--LITERAL_SWITCH -&gt; switch
6529     * |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6530     * |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6531     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; o
6532     * |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6533     * |   |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6534     * |   |--SWITCH_RULE -&gt; SWITCH_RULE
6535     * |   |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case
6536     * |   |   |   `--RECORD_PATTERN_DEF -&gt; RECORD_PATTERN_DEF
6537     * |   |   |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6538     * |   |   |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6539     * |   |   |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; R
6540     * |   |   |       |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6541     * |   |   |       |--RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS -&gt; RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS
6542     * |   |   |       |   `--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6543     * |   |   |       |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6544     * |   |   |       |       |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6545     * |   |   |       |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; String
6546     * |   |   |       |       `--IDENT -&gt; s
6547     * |   |   |       |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6548     * |   |   |       `--IDENT -&gt; myRecord
6549     * |   |   |--LAMBDA -&gt; -&gt;
6550     * |   |   `--SLIST -&gt; {
6551     * |   |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6552     * |   `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6553     * `--RCURLY -&gt; }
6554     * </pre>
6555     *
6556     * @see <a href="https://openjdk.org/jeps/405">JEP 405: Record Patterns</a>
6557     * @see #LITERAL_WHEN
6558     * @see #PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6559     * @see #LITERAL_INSTANCEOF
6560     * @see #SWITCH_RULE
6561     *
6562     * @since 10.12.0
6563     */
6564    public static final int RECORD_PATTERN_DEF =
6565        JavaLanguageLexer.RECORD_PATTERN_DEF;

6598     * |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6599     * |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6600     * |   |   `--LITERAL_INSTANCEOF -&gt; instanceof
6601     * |   |       |--IDENT -&gt; o
6602     * |   |       `--RECORD_PATTERN_DEF -&gt; RECORD_PATTERN_DEF

6604     * |   |           |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE

6606     * |   |           |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6607     * |   |           |--RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS -&gt; RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS

6609     * |   |           |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS

6611     * |   |           |       |   `--IDENT -&gt; String

6613     * |   |           `--RPAREN -&gt; )
6614     * |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )

6616     * |       `--RCURLY -&gt; }

6619     * |   |--EXPR -&gt; EXPR
6620     * |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; o
6621     * |   |--RPAREN -&gt; )
6622     * |   |--LCURLY -&gt; {
6623     * |   |--SWITCH_RULE -&gt; SWITCH_RULE
6624     * |   |   |--LITERAL_CASE -&gt; case

6626     * |   |   |       `--LITERAL_WHEN -&gt; when
6627     * |   |   |           |--RECORD_PATTERN_DEF -&gt; RECORD_PATTERN_DEF
6628     * |   |   |           |   |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS
6629     * |   |   |           |   |--TYPE -&gt; TYPE
6630     * |   |   |           |   |   `--IDENT -&gt; R
6631     * |   |   |           |   |--LPAREN -&gt; (
6632     * |   |   |           |   |--RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS -&gt; RECORD_PATTERN_COMPONENTS
6633     * |   |   |           |   |   `--PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF -&gt; PATTERN_VARIABLE_DEF
6634     * |   |   |           |   |       |--MODIFIERS -&gt; MODIFIERS

6763    /**
