6779     *  |--LITERAL_MODULE -> module
6780     *  |--DOT -> .
6781     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6782     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6783     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6784     *  |   `--IDENT -> app
6785     *  `--DIRECTIVE_BLOCK -> DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6786     *      |--LCURLY -> {
6787     *      `--RCURLY -> }
6788     * </pre>
6789     *
6790     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7">
6791     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7</a>
6792     * @see #MODULE_DEF
6793     *
6794     * @since 14.0.0
6795     */
6796    public static final int LITERAL_OPEN = JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_OPEN;
6797
6798    /**
6799     * A {@code transitive} keyword. This keyword is a modifier of a
6800     * {@link #REQUIRES} directive and appears as a child of it.
6801     *
6802     * <p>For example:</p>
6803     * <pre>
6804     * requires transitive java.sql;
6805     * </pre>
6806     *
6807     * <p>parses as:</p>
6808     * <pre>
6809     * REQUIRES -> requires
6810     *  |--LITERAL_TRANSITIVE -> transitive
6811     *  |--DOT -> .
6812     *  |   |--IDENT -> java
6813     *  |   `--IDENT -> sql
6814     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6815     * </pre>
6816     *
6817     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.1">
6818     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.1</a>
6819     * @see #REQUIRES
6820     *
6821     * @since 14.0.0
6822     */
6823    public static final int LITERAL_TRANSITIVE = JavaLanguageLexer.LITERAL_TRANSITIVE;
6824
6825    /**
6826     * A module declaration. The declaration of a Java Platform Module System
6827     * module, as found in a {@code module-info.java} file. Its children are
6828     * an {@link #ANNOTATIONS} node (which may be empty), an optional
6829     * {@link #LITERAL_OPEN}, a {@link #LITERAL_MODULE}, the module name, and
6830     * a {@link #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK}.
6831     *
6832     * <p>For example:</p>
6833     * <pre>
6834     * module com.example.app {
6835     *     requires java.base;
6836     * }
6837     * </pre>
6838     *
6839     * <p>parses as:</p>
6840     * <pre>
6841     * COMPILATION_UNIT -> COMPILATION_UNIT
6842     *  `--MODULE_DEF -> MODULE_DEF
6843     *      |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
6844     *      |--LITERAL_MODULE -> module
6845     *      |--DOT -> .
6846     *      |   |--DOT -> .
6847     *      |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6848     *      |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6849     *      |   `--IDENT -> app
6850     *      `--DIRECTIVE_BLOCK -> DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6851     *          |--LCURLY -> {
6852     *          |--REQUIRES -> requires
6853     *          |   |--DOT -> .
6854     *          |   |   |--IDENT -> java
6855     *          |   |   `--IDENT -> base
6856     *          |   `--SEMI -> ;
6857     *          `--RCURLY -> }
6858     * </pre>
6859     *
6860     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7">
6861     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7</a>
6862     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6863     * @see #LITERAL_MODULE
6864     * @see #LITERAL_OPEN
6865     * @see #ANNOTATIONS
6866     *
6867     * @since 14.0.0
6868     */
6869    public static final int MODULE_DEF = JavaLanguageLexer.MODULE_DEF;
6870
6871    /**
6872     * A directive block. The braced body of a module declaration, containing
6873     * zero or more module directives. It is a child of {@link #MODULE_DEF}.
6874     *
6875     * <p>For example:</p>
6876     * <pre>
6877     * module com.example.app {
6878     *     uses com.example.api.Service;
6879     * }
6880     * </pre>
6881     *
6882     * <p>parses as:</p>
6883     * <pre>
6884     * MODULE_DEF -> MODULE_DEF
6885     *  |--ANNOTATIONS -> ANNOTATIONS
6886     *  |--LITERAL_MODULE -> module
6887     *  |--DOT -> .
6888     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6889     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6890     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6891     *  |   `--IDENT -> app
6892     *  `--DIRECTIVE_BLOCK -> DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6893     *      |--LCURLY -> {
6894     *      |--USES -> uses
6895     *      |   |--DOT -> .
6896     *      |   |   |--DOT -> .
6897     *      |   |   |   |--DOT -> .
6898     *      |   |   |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6899     *      |   |   |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6900     *      |   |   |   `--IDENT -> api
6901     *      |   |   `--IDENT -> Service
6902     *      |   `--SEMI -> ;
6903     *      `--RCURLY -> }
6904     * </pre>
6905     *
6906     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7">
6907     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7</a>
6908     * @see #MODULE_DEF
6909     *
6910     * @since 14.0.0
6911     */
6912    public static final int DIRECTIVE_BLOCK = JavaLanguageLexer.DIRECTIVE_BLOCK;
6913
6914    /**
6915     * A requires directive. Declares a dependence of the current module on
6916     * another module. Its children are optional {@link #LITERAL_TRANSITIVE}
6917     * or {@link #LITERAL_STATIC} modifiers, the name of the required module,
6918     * and a semicolon.
6919     *
6920     * <p>For example:</p>
6921     * <pre>
6922     * requires transitive java.sql;
6923     * </pre>
6924     *
6925     * <p>parses as:</p>
6926     * <pre>
6927     * REQUIRES -> requires
6928     *  |--LITERAL_TRANSITIVE -> transitive
6929     *  |--DOT -> .
6930     *  |   |--IDENT -> java
6931     *  |   `--IDENT -> sql
6932     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6933     * </pre>
6934     *
6935     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.1">
6936     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.1</a>
6937     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6938     * @see #LITERAL_TRANSITIVE
6939     * @see #LITERAL_STATIC
6940     *
6941     * @since 14.0.0
6942     */
6943    public static final int REQUIRES = JavaLanguageLexer.REQUIRES;
6944
6945    /**
6946     * An exports directive. Makes a package of the current module accessible
6947     * to other modules. Its children are the exported package name, an
6948     * optional {@link #TO} clause, and a semicolon.
6949     *
6950     * <p>For example:</p>
6951     * <pre>
6952     * exports com.example.api to com.example.one, com.example.two;
6953     * </pre>
6954     *
6955     * <p>parses as:</p>
6956     * <pre>
6957     * EXPORTS -> exports
6958     *  |--DOT -> .
6959     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6960     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6961     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6962     *  |   `--IDENT -> api
6963     *  |--TO -> to
6964     *  |   |--DOT -> .
6965     *  |   |   |--DOT -> .
6966     *  |   |   |   |--IDENT -> com
6967     *  |   |   |   `--IDENT -> example
6968     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> one
6969     *  |   |--COMMA -> ,
6970     *  |   `--DOT -> .
6971     *  |       |--DOT -> .
6972     *  |       |   |--IDENT -> com
6973     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> example
6974     *  |       `--IDENT -> two
6975     *  `--SEMI -> ;
6976     * </pre>
6977     *
6978     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.2">
6979     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.2</a>
6980     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
6981     * @see #TO
6982     *
6983     * @since 14.0.0
6984     */
6985    public static final int EXPORTS = JavaLanguageLexer.EXPORTS;
6986
6987    /**
6988     * An opens directive. Makes a package of the current module available for
6989     * deep reflection to other modules. Its children are the opened package
6990     * name, an optional {@link #TO} clause, and a semicolon.
6991     *
6992     * <p>For example:</p>
6993     * <pre>
6994     * opens com.example.model;
6995     * </pre>
6996     *
6997     * <p>parses as:</p>
6998     * <pre>
6999     * OPENS -> opens
7000     *  |--DOT -> .
7001     *  |   |--DOT -> .
7002     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
7003     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
7004     *  |   `--IDENT -> model
7005     *  `--SEMI -> ;
7006     * </pre>
7007     *
7008     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.2">
7009     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.2</a>
7010     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
7011     * @see #TO
7012     *
7013     * @since 14.0.0
7014     */
7015    public static final int OPENS = JavaLanguageLexer.OPENS;
7016
7017    /**
7018     * A uses directive. Declares a service whose implementations the current
7019     * module discovers via {@code java.util.ServiceLoader}. Its children are
7020     * the service type name and a semicolon.
7021     *
7022     * <p>For example:</p>
7023     * <pre>
7024     * uses com.example.api.Service;
7025     * </pre>
7026     *
7027     * <p>parses as:</p>
7028     * <pre>
7029     * USES -> uses
7030     *  |--DOT -> .
7031     *  |   |--DOT -> .
7032     *  |   |   |--DOT -> .
7033     *  |   |   |   |--IDENT -> com
7034     *  |   |   |   `--IDENT -> example
7035     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> api
7036     *  |   `--IDENT -> Service
7037     *  `--SEMI -> ;
7038     * </pre>
7039     *
7040     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.3">
7041     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.3</a>
7042     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
7043     *
7044     * @since 14.0.0
7045     */
7046    public static final int USES = JavaLanguageLexer.USES;
7047
7048    /**
7049     * A provides directive. Declares implementations of a service that the
7050     * current module supplies. Its children are the service type name, a
7051     * {@link #WITH} clause, and a semicolon.
7052     *
7053     * <p>For example:</p>
7054     * <pre>
7055     * provides com.example.Service with com.example.Impl;
7056     * </pre>
7057     *
7058     * <p>parses as:</p>
7059     * <pre>
7060     * PROVIDES -> provides
7061     *  |--DOT -> .
7062     *  |   |--DOT -> .
7063     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
7064     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
7065     *  |   `--IDENT -> Service
7066     *  |--WITH -> with
7067     *  |   `--DOT -> .
7068     *  |       |--DOT -> .
7069     *  |       |   |--IDENT -> com
7070     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> example
7071     *  |       `--IDENT -> Impl
7072     *  `--SEMI -> ;
7073     * </pre>
7074     *
7075     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.4">
7076     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.4</a>
7077     * @see #DIRECTIVE_BLOCK
7078     * @see #WITH
7079     *
7080     * @since 14.0.0
7081     */
7082    public static final int PROVIDES = JavaLanguageLexer.PROVIDES;
7083
7084    /**
7085     * A to clause. Limits an {@link #EXPORTS} or {@link #OPENS} directive to
7086     * the named friend modules. Its children are the module names, separated
7087     * by commas.
7088     *
7089     * <p>For example:</p>
7090     * <pre>
7091     * opens com.example.secrets to com.example.friend;
7092     * </pre>
7093     *
7094     * <p>parses as:</p>
7095     * <pre>
7096     * OPENS -> opens
7097     *  |--DOT -> .
7098     *  |   |--DOT -> .
7099     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
7100     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
7101     *  |   `--IDENT -> secrets
7102     *  |--TO -> to
7103     *  |   `--DOT -> .
7104     *  |       |--DOT -> .
7105     *  |       |   |--IDENT -> com
7106     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> example
7107     *  |       `--IDENT -> friend
7108     *  `--SEMI -> ;
7109     * </pre>
7110     *
7111     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.2">
7112     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.2</a>
7113     * @see #EXPORTS
7114     * @see #OPENS
7115     *
7116     * @since 14.0.0
7117     */
7118    public static final int TO = JavaLanguageLexer.TO;
7119
7120    /**
7121     * A with clause. Names the implementation types supplied by a
7122     * {@link #PROVIDES} directive. Its children are the implementation type
7123     * names, separated by commas.
7124     *
7125     * <p>For example:</p>
7126     * <pre>
7127     * provides com.example.Service with com.example.Impl;
7128     * </pre>
7129     *
7130     * <p>parses as:</p>
7131     * <pre>
7132     * PROVIDES -> provides
7133     *  |--DOT -> .
7134     *  |   |--DOT -> .
7135     *  |   |   |--IDENT -> com
7136     *  |   |   `--IDENT -> example
7137     *  |   `--IDENT -> Service
7138     *  |--WITH -> with
7139     *  |   `--DOT -> .
7140     *  |       |--DOT -> .
7141     *  |       |   |--IDENT -> com
7142     *  |       |   `--IDENT -> example
7143     *  |       `--IDENT -> Impl
7144     *  `--SEMI -> ;
7145     * </pre>
7146     *
7147     * @see <a href="https://docs.oracle.com/javase/specs/jls/se25/html/jls-7.html#jls-7.7.4">
7148     *     Java Language Specification, &sect;7.7.4</a>
7149     * @see #PROVIDES
7150     *
7151     * @since 14.0.0
7152     */
7153    public static final int WITH = JavaLanguageLexer.WITH;
7154
7155    /** Prevent instantiation. */
7156    private TokenTypes() {
7157    }
7158
7159}
